 Interested?

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
**Overview:** 
 The Technical Project Manager (Business Performance) will drive the technology initiatives that translate advanced data into business\-critical impact. This role sits at the intersection of Business Analytics and our Internal AI Innovation Hub, driving the deployment of enterprise intelligence capabilities and AI\-driven applications. You will act as the crucial operational bridge between strategic business objectives and the technical teams delivering these cutting\-edge analytics and AI solutions.
   

  

**Duties And Responsibilities**
* Analytics Platform Delivery: Orchestrate end\-to\-end technical projects to deploy, scale, and refine the analytics for delivering automated, decision\-ready enterprise performance views.
* AI Innovation Lifecycle: Manage the project lifecycle for the Internal AI Innovation Hub, guiding new automated agents and applications from rapid prototyping and pilot testing to full enterprise production.
* Requirements Translation: Partner closely with US\-based business leaders and local teams as needed to translate complex analytical goals into clear, executable project plans, scope definitions, and technical requirements.
* Project Governance: Drive project execution, establish key milestones, monitor timelines, manage resources, and actively resolve risks or blockers for data engineering and development teams.

* Status \& Progress Tracking: Organize and lead project status updates, prepare and distribute progress reports, and correct deviations from project baselines.


**Job Requirements**

* Modern PM Stack: Advanced proficiency with project management tools.

* Ability to influence team members and business partners toward common goals.
* Ability to build trust and cultivate relationships with diverse internal and external stakeholders.

**Education:**

title: Infrastructure Project Manager
description:

**Job Title: Infrastructure Project Manager**
 At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

 At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 Within Enterprise Technology, Program Execution is responsible for managing all aspects of project and program delivery including:
   

  

* Portfolio Project demand management lifecycle
* Business and data analysis
* Project and program implementation
* Portfolio projects delivery management


 Ultimately the team must ensure projects are delivered to time, budget and quality targets that ensure ET itself delivers on its commitments to global and member firm stakeholders.
   

  

 This is a leadership role, and the candidate will lead a hardworking team who are responsible for delivering projects and programs across large parts of EY globally.
   

  

 This role will be responsible for driving all aspects of project and program delivery from project demand through project delivery, setting and driving the highest possible standards for time, budget and quality delivery and working closely with the Business Office on financial tracking and forecasting.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 As a Project Manager the role will:
   

  

* Direct and manage the successful delivery of projects being delivered across the EY Globally, consisting of multiple complex project plans, objectives and change initiatives, in line with organizational policies and strategies.
* Review projects plans, technical roadmaps, risks etc and make recommendations to senior business leaders within EY, negotiating on technical and commercial issues.
* Ensure all projects are established and managed in adherence to project governance frameworks and the SOWs.
* Manage activities and processes related to the tracking, analysis, and reporting against all key performance targets for the business.
* Be responsible for the tracking and management of vendor agreements and contracts that leverage project management services.
* Maintain a deep understanding of internal and external developments to recognize and address any potential impacts on IT programs and identify, implement and promote sharing of best practices and new technologies e.g., through Communities of Practice;
* Develop and drive quality initiatives that increase delivery confidence and align with industry standards.
* Focus on ensuring delivery to time, budget and quality is achieved through the development of talent aligned to the needs of the business whilst recognizing and rewarding success.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* A proven track record of delivering transformation projects and programs globally across EY
* Ability to challenge and push back to the business ensuring new project demand is appropriate and timely – especially where being proposed outside of the annual planning process.
* Ability to lead and motivate a globally dispersed team of varying backgrounds, skills and experiences.
* Ability to bring impactful thought leadership for use in evolving project management within EY
* Possess strong strategic capabilities as well as the capacity to foster new ways of thinking and develop new approaches that can be applied to a variety of challenges.
* Expert knowledge of Project Management, IT governance formulation, and team management.
* Strong knowledge of IT risk management, IT standards and policies formulation.
* Expert understanding of IT infrastructure design and delivery.


**To qualify for the role you must have**
**Project Planning \& Delivery**
* Lead end\-to\-end project lifecycle from initiation through closure.
* Define project scope, objectives, deliverables, milestones, and success criteria.
* Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, budgets, and resource plans.
* Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and according to quality standards.


**Governance \& Reporting**
* Establish project governance framework and reporting cadence.
* Prepare status reports, dashboards, RAID logs, and executive updates.
* Conduct steering committee reviews and project health assessments.
* Track project performance against baseline plans and KPIs.


**Risk \& Issue Management**
* Identify project risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies.
* Drive mitigation plans and resolution activities.
* Escalate critical concerns to leadership when required.
* Manage project change requests and scope control processes


**Stakeholder Management**
* Build strong relationships with business sponsors, leadership teams, vendors, and project stakeholders.
* Facilitate decision\-making and conflict resolution.
* Manage stakeholder expectations throughout the project lifecycle


**Team Leadership**
* Lead cross\-functional teams across business and technology functions.
* Allocate resources and monitor team performance.
* Coach and mentor junior project coordinators and project managers.
* Foster collaboration and accountability across teams


**Financial Management**
* Manage project budgets, forecasts, and financial tracking.
* Monitor actuals versus plan.
* Control project costs and improve delivery efficiency.


**What We Offer**
 As part of this role, you'll work in a highly integrated, global team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The EY benefits package goes above and beyond too, focusing on your physical, emotional, financial and social well\-being. Your recruiter can talk to you about the benefits available in your country. Here’s a snapshot of what we offer:
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Project Manager
description:
Organization:
 



  





 FIND accelerates equitable access to reliable diagnosis around the world. We are working to close critical testing gaps that leave people at risk from preventable and treatable illnesses, enable effective disease surveillance, and build sustainable, resilient health systems. In partnership with countries, WHO and other global health agencies, we are driving progress towards global health security and universal health coverage. We are a WHO Collaborating Centre for Laboratory Strengthening and Diagnostic Technology Evaluation. For more information, please visit www.finddx.org
 



  





 Location: New Delhi, India
 



 Work Model: Hybrid (3 days in office and 2 days WFH per week)
 



  





 The ADAPT\-TB project aims to improve the diagnosis of pediatric tuberculosis in India by evaluating the use of non\-invasive, child\-friendly specimens (stool, tongue swabs and urine) along with other routine samples across multiple indigenous molecular diagnostic platforms in the TB diagnostic landscape.
 



  





 The project will be implemented across 11 tertiary care facilities across India in close collaboration with the National TB Elimination Programme (NTEP), and stakeholders at the national, state and district levels. The study will generate evidence on diagnostic accuracy and operational feasibility to inform national scale\-up.
 



  





 The Project Manager will provide overall project management support for the implementation of Project ADAPT\-TB, including day\-to\-day coordination with participating sites, monitoring project progress, review of operational and data\-related outputs, and reporting to project leadership and key stakeholders. The incumbent will lead coordination across all project sites, ensure achievement of project milestones and documentation requirements, and support effective implementation in accordance with donor requirements and organizational standards.
 



  





 The specific activities will include but not be limited to:
 



  




* Develop, implement, and maintain project workplans, workflows, monitoring tools, and tracking systems to support effective project execution.
* Coordinate and oversee implementation of project activities across all participating sites, ensuring timely delivery of outputs and outcomes.
* Monitor project progress against established milestones, deliverables, budgets, and timelines, and recommend corrective actions where required.
* Lead coordination with tertiary institutes, state health authorities, manufacturers, research partners, and other key stakeholders to facilitate smooth project implementation.
* Provide technical and operational support to project sites and ensure adherence to approved protocols and implementation plans.
* Facilitate and coordinate regulatory approvals, including HMSC, IEC, and other relevant clearances in collaboration with participating institutions.
* Ensure standardization and quality assurance of project processes, including validation of sample processing techniques and data management procedures.
* Organize and lead project meetings, trainings, workshops, and stakeholder consultations.

We're Hiring \| Project Engineer (Site Deployment, CNG / LNG Stations)
 



  





 📍 Location: Gujarat, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh,
 



 Haryana, Punjab, Maharashtra and Union Territory of Dadra \& Nagar Haveli
 



  
 



 🏢 Company: Meenaar Global Consultants LLP
 



 🏭 Industry: Oil \& Gas \| CGD \| CNG / LNG \| Hydrocarbon \| Pipeline \| Refinery \| Petrochemical
 



 💼 Experience: 4\+ Years (Diploma Engineer) \| 2\+ Years (Diploma Engineer with CNG/LNG experience)
 



  
 



 Meenaar Global Consultants LLP is seeking a Project Engineer for full\-time.The role covers day\-to\-day coordination with stakeholders for the timely commissioning of CNG stations, across CNG/LNG stations and facilities, office building construction sites and CGS sites as per tender scope.
 



 This role is ideal for professionals with experience in LNG/CNG system design or project execution in the hydrocarbon industry, including process plants, pipelines (hydrocarbon, crude oil, gas), petrochemical plants, LPG plants and refineries.
 



  
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Ensure day\-to\-day coordination with all stakeholders for timely commissioning of CNG stations.
* Supervise and monitor construction activities at CNG/LNG stations and facilities, office building construction sites and CGS sites as per tender scope.
* Coordinate with contractors, vendors, consultants for smooth site execution.
* Monitor work progress against schedule and highlight delays or issues to the Project Manager.
* Ensure work is carried out as per approved drawings, specifications standards.
* Support inspection, testing, pre\-commissioning and commissioning activities.
* Coordinate material requirements, availability and site readiness.
* Ensure compliance with HSE requirements and permit\-to\-work systems at site.
* Prepare and submit daily, weekly and monthly progress reports.
* Maintain site records, documentation and tracking registers.



  
 



**Qualifications \& Experience** 



* Diploma in Engineering (any discipline) from a recognized institution.
* Minimum 4 years of relevant experience as a Diploma Engineer, or minimum 2 years of experience for candidates with CNG/LNG segment experience.
* Experience in LNG/CNG system design or project execution in any hydrocarbon industry, such as hydrocarbon process plants, pipelines (hydrocarbon/crude oil/gas), petrochemical plants, LPG plants, refineries, etc.
* Experience in coordinating with stakeholders at site and supporting timely project completion.
* Willingness to work full time at the deployed site.



  
 



**Preferred Skills** 



* Oil \& Gas \| CGD \| CNG / LNG Station Construction
* Project Execution \& Site Coordination
* Stakeholder \& Contractor Coordination
* Construction Progress Monitoring
* Commissioning Support
* Hydrocarbon Piping, Pipeline \& Process Plant Exposure
* HSE \& PTW Awareness
* MIS \& Periodic Reporting
* MS Excel \| MS Word \| MS PowerPoint
* Documentation \& Record Management



  
 



**Why Join Us?** 



* Opportunity to work on CNG/LNG projects
* Exposure to CNG/LNG stations, CGS sites and building construction activities.
* Opportunity to coordinate with contractors, vendors and project stakeholders.
* Professional and technically driven work environment.
* 



 📩 Interested candidates may share their updated CV at: careers@mgcllp.in

description:

We bring together a global community of experts to deliver meaningful impact for our clients and the planet.

-

**Working Model**
* The role follows a hybrid working arrangement, designed to facilitate effective global collaboration. Team members are expected to work between 14:00 and 23:00 IST. There may also be occasions when extended working hours are necessary to accommodate cross\-time\-zone activities.

title: Dam Instrumentation & Monitoring Specialist (International Expert)
description:
**Position Title: Dam Instrumentation \& Monitoring Specialist \[International Expert]**
**Key Qualifications/ Requirements**
 He/she should have a degree in any branch of Engineering and should have at least of 10 years in planning of instrumentations, technical specifications of instruments, SCADA, Surveillance, Control System, and automation in dams, data analysis, preparation of instrumentation plan of dams, work supervision of installation and commissioning of dam instrumentation etc. in minimum 3 large dams.
   

  

**Job Descriptions**
* Serve as the Nodal Expert for overall coordination and implementation of DHARMA after DTL and TL.
* Review instrumentation action plans in all Project Screening Templates (PSTs) and finalize them concerning instrumentation, SCADA, and Surveillance \& Control Systems.
* Provide technical support for the establishment of Centralized Control and Command Centers in various State capitals and individual control rooms at DRIP dams.
* Oversee data collection, transmission, processing, and analysis, and finalize outcome report protocols.
* Ensure proper O\&M of established instrumentation at DRIP dams.
* Manage technical hardware, software, and data transmission for all instrumentation plans designed or received from DRIP IAs.
* Prepare technical bid documents as needed, focusing on bill of quantities, technical specifications, and instrument selection based on dam type.
* Define qualifying criteria for instrumentation and monitoring systems.
* Conduct third\-party CS\&QA inspections and manage transmittals.
* Facilitate capacity building of DRIP IAs through customized training programs at various levels.
* Contribute to the revision of existing guidelines and the formulation of new guidelines related to instrumentation and monitoring.
* Provide inputs for the National Website for dam safety information and the MIS system.
* Support the development of in\-house expertise at select Academic Institutes.
* Develop the Training Calendar for DHARMA implementation and customized training programs on Instrumentation and Monitoring Systems for the annual DRIP Calendar.
* Conduct need\-based inspections of DRIP dams.
* Accompany central DSRP panels for special dam safety issues.
* Manage any DRIP\-related activities assigned by the Project Director, DRIP, CWC.

 **Project Manager \- Landscape Architect**

**Job Summary:** 




 We are seeking a highly experienced and forward\-thinking
 **Project Manager – Landscape Architecture** 
 to join our growing team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for leading end\-to\-end landscape architecture projects, from concept to execution, with a strong emphasis on
 **BIM integration** 
 ,
 **sustainability**

* Bachelor’s degree in Landscape Architecture, Architecture, or a related field (Mandatory).
* Master’s degree in Landscape Architecture or Urban Design (Preferred).

* Working knowledge of SketchUp, Rhino, or Grasshopper for conceptual design and visualizations is a plus.
* Strong grasp of site planning, horticulture, grading, hardscape detailing, and sustainable landscape systems.

* Demonstrated ability to manage multidisciplinary teams, budgets, schedules, and client expectations.

**Benefits:** 



* Competitive salary with performance\-based incentives.
* Professional development opportunities, including training and certifications.
* Exposure to international and landmark projects.
* A collaborative, innovation\-driven work culture that values design excellence.

title: Project Manager
description:
**\#\# About LoopClosers AI** 




  





 LoopClosers AI is a marketing technology company building AI\-native platforms for consumer brands. Our agentic marketing platform and conversational agents help marketing teams plan, execute, and evaluate multi\-channel campaigns end\-to\-end across WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, RCS, web, and voice. Our products are used today by automotive OEMs, D2C brands, and other consumer businesses.
 



 We are a small, senior team with a strong bias for shipping. We work on high\-leverage problems, in\-person, from Gurugram and Bengaluru.
 



  





**\#\# Role Overview** 




  





 We are looking for a Project Manager to own the
 **post\-sale deployment** 
 of our agentic AI and conversational marketing programs for enterprise and mid\-market customers. Once a deal is signed, you are the single point of accountability for taking the customer from kickoff to live campaigns \- coordinating our engineering, creative, and account teams alongside the customer's marketing, IT, and compliance stakeholders.
 



 The programs you will run typically involve:
 



 \- Overseeing build and deployment of AI agents across WhatsApp Business API, Instagram, Messenger, RCS, web chat, and voice.
 



 \- Onboarding brand assets, content libraries, and product catalogues into our platform.
 



 \- Coordinating BSP / CPaaS setup \- number provisioning, template approvals, opt\-in flows, and compliance reviews.
 



 \- Instrumenting campaigns, dashboards, and reporting so the customer sees measurable outcomes.
 



 This is a hands\-on delivery role with substantial ownership. You will be the person the customer calls when something needs to happen, and the person our internal team looks to for prioritisation and clarity.
 



  





**\#\# Responsibilities** 




  





 \- Own end\-to\-end post\-sale deployment for a portfolio of customer accounts — from kickoff through go\-live and steady\-state operations.
 



 \- Build and maintain deployment plans, RACI, and status trackers for each account; run weekly steering calls with customer stakeholders.
 



 \- Coordinate WhatsApp Business API, RCS, and other channel onboarding with BSPs and CPaaS partners (template submissions, number provisioning, DLT/compliance, opt\-in flows).
 



 \- Translate customer requirements into clear scoped tickets for the engineering, creative, and agent\-config teams, and hold the timeline for delivery.
 



 \- Drive user acceptance testing, sign\-offs, and phased rollouts.
 



 \- Track program health — SLA adherence, milestone burn\-down, open risks — and escalate early with proposed mitigations.
 



 \- Own post\-launch operations for the first 30–90 days: campaign calendars, performance reviews, change requests, and hand\-off to steady\-state support.
 



 \- Feed field learnings back into the product team so common gaps become platform capabilities.
 



  





**\#\# Required Qualifications** 




  





 \-
 **1–2 years of experience in the CPaaS industry** 
 delivering conversational or messaging deployments for enterprise customers.
 



 \- Working knowledge of at least : Agentic AI, RAG Systems, Image AI, Video AI, WhatsApp API, voice bots, or web chat channels.
 



 \- Demonstrated ownership of at least one multi\-stakeholder customer deployment from kickoff to go\-live.
 



 \- Strong written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to run structured status calls with senior customer stakeholders.
 



 \- Comfort with fast\-paced cycles, ambiguity, and running multiple parallel accounts.
 



 \- Based in Gurugram or Bengaluru, and comfortable working in\-person from our office.
 



  





**\#\# Preferred Qualifications** 




  





 \- Experience deploying
 **agentic AI, conversational AI, or chatbot** 
 solutions for consumer brands.
 



 \- Prior work with D2C, retail, BFSI, or automotive customers on marketing or customer\-engagement programs.
 



 \- Familiarity with campaign performance metrics (delivery, open, CTR, conversion, ROAS) and reporting tools.
 



 \- Exposure to CRM, marketing automation, or analytics stacks (Zoho, Salesforce, HubSpot, Meta Business Suite, GA4\).
 



  





**\#\# What We Offer** 




  





 \- Fixed compensation in the range of
 **₹8\-9 LPA** 
 , aligned with junior program\-management roles in Gurugram and Bengaluru.
 



 \- Direct exposure to founders, customers, and the product roadmap, with meaningful ownership over the accounts you run.

title: Manage - Transformation & Operations
description:
**Manager, Transformation \& Operations** 




  





**Location:** 
 Gurgaon, Haryana, India
 



**Experience:** 
 10\-15 years
 



  





**About the Company** 




 Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M) is a global professional services firm providing advisory, business performance improvement, turnaround management, and interim leadership services to companies, investors, and government entities. Founded in 1983 as a restructuring boutique, A\&M is known for practical, action\-oriented solutions that help organizations tackle complex issues, improve operating performance, create value, and accelerate results across six continents. Its mission is to help organizations solve complex business issues and maximize stakeholder value. A\&M’s culture is grounded in Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity, with founding principles of Leadership, Action, and Results. In 2023, A\&M established a Global Capability Center in India to support business units across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC. The GCC partners with case teams on end\-to\-end delivery and thought leadership, serving industries including Consumer and Retail, Healthcare, Software and Technology, Automotive and Industrials, Hospitality and Leisure, Energy and Natural Resources, and Financial Services. The center has grown to more than 1,000 professionals.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 As Manager, Transformation \& Operations, you will own transformation workstreams and operational initiatives within A\&M’s Corporate Shared Services team in the Gurgaon Global Capability Center. Reporting to the Director of Corporate Shared Services \& Operations, you will convert strategic priorities into executable plans, reliable transitions, improved processes, and reusable operating capability. Your scope will span GCC/GBS transition planning, process design, documentation, business\-case analysis, and operational excellence across functions such as HR, Marketing, and IT. This is a senior execution role for a hands\-on operator with consulting rigor. You will work independently with functional teams, local operations, regional partners, and senior leaders while influencing without direct authority. The role is not a people\-management position or a client\-facing advisory role, although you will mentor junior colleagues and contribute to capability building.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own two to three transformation or operational workstreams from planning through execution, using structured project plans, risk controls, quality reviews, and leadership reporting to deliver agreed outcomes.
* Execute GCC process transitions through detailed plans, handover controls, process documentation, training content, and change support that enable stable adoption by functional and operations teams.
* Design and maintain reusable playbooks, job aids, process libraries, and knowledge assets that codify best practices, improve consistency, and reduce dependency on individual process owners.
* Analyze costs, volumes, productivity, and efficiency metrics to identify improvement opportunities and build financial models, ROI calculations, and business cases for leadership decisions.
* Translate complex operational information into clear leadership updates, recommendations, and implementation priorities that support operating model governance and timely decisions.
* Partner with HR, Marketing, IT, regional teams, and GCC operations to resolve dependencies, influence without direct authority, and maintain momentum across interconnected initiatives.
* Mentor junior team members in consulting\-style problem\-solving, documentation standards, and execution discipline while supporting training plans for new associates.
* Track lessons learned and transition outcomes to strengthen future implementation methods, improve operational readiness, and build scalable capability across the growing GCC.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* 10–15 years of experience, including at least 10 years in GCC/GBS transformation, shared services, operations consulting, or project\-delivery\-focused corporate operations roles.
* Strong knowledge of GCC/GBS operating models, shared services best practices, transition planning, process improvement, process documentation, and execution\-level change management.
* Demonstrated ownership of complex workstreams from planning through delivery, with the ability to manage risks, dependencies, deliverable quality, and multiple moving pieces independently.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capability, including cost, volume, efficiency, financial modelling, business\-case development, and ROI analysis.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to create clear documentation, training materials, leadership updates, and actionable recommendations.
* Ability to collaborate across functions and geographies, influence stakeholders without direct authority, and present findings effectively to functional leaders and operations teams.
* Master of Business Administration in Operations or Finance, with prior consulting firm experience and knowledge of India GCC or multinational shared services environments preferred.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* Experience delivering GCC/GBS transformation engagements, shared services implementations, or operating model transitions across multiple corporate functions.
* Prior experience in a Big Four firm, boutique consulting firm, consulting practice, or a comparable transformation\-focused operations environment.
* Exposure to building reusable playbooks, process libraries, training programs, and capability\-development mechanisms for growing operations teams.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* You bring 10–15 years of professional experience, including 10 or more years in GCC/GBS transformation, operations consulting, shared services, or project\-delivery\-focused corporate operations. Your experience shows sustained ownership of complex execution rather than strategy recommendations alone.
* You bring hands\-on capability in workstream management, transition planning, process improvement, documentation, and change execution. You can turn broad priorities into detailed plans, control risks, maintain quality, and deliver outcomes with limited supervision.
* You bring strong analytical and commercial judgment, including the ability to assess costs, volumes, efficiency, ROI, and operating trade\-offs. You can build credible financial models and business cases that help leaders prioritize investments and improvements.
* You bring a Master of Business Administration in Operations or Finance and communicate with clarity across senior leaders, functional teams, regional partners, and operations colleagues. You influence without authority, manage detail, mentor others, and remain effective in a fast\-paced, entrepreneurial environment.



  





**Why Join Us** 




 At Alvarez \& Marsal, you will join a global professional services firm where practical execution, independent thinking, and measurable results shape the work. This role offers the opportunity to help build and strengthen a rapidly growing Global Capability Center in India while working directly with local and global leadership. You will have visibility into strategic decision\-making and direct ownership of transformation workstreams that influence how corporate functions operate and scale. The small central operations team provides meaningful responsibility, close collaboration, and room to expand your scope as the GCC and its capabilities grow. You will work across functions, geographies, and industries while building expertise in transitions, operating models, process improvement, and business performance. A\&M supports professional growth through mentorship, formal training, A\&M University, on\-the\-job learning, internal mobility, and performance development. The culture values integrity, quality, objectivity, inclusive diversity, and personal contribution, while encouraging people to bring an entrepreneurial, action\-oriented approach to complex problems.
 



  





**What We Offer** 



* Direct exposure to local and global leadership, meaningful ownership of transformation workstreams, and the opportunity to influence operating practices within a rapidly growing India Global Capability Center.
* A development environment combining formal training, A\&M University, mentorship, on\-the\-job learning, performance development, and internal mobility for continued professional growth.
* Competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, wellness resources, work\-life balance support, employee resource groups, flexible work models, and opportunities to contribute to community programs.

title: Senior Program Associate
description:
**Program Associate \- PGP \|\| Altera Institute \- Digiaccel Learning** 




  





 At Digiaccel Learning and Altera Institute, we are on a mission to build the next generation of business leaders equipped for a digital and AI\-first world. Today, we are known in the industry for our deep education expertise in domains such as eCommerce, Growth, Marketing, Brand, Product \& AI. Through industry\-led learning, real\-world projects, and deep partnerships with leading companies, we are redefining management education and creating meaningful career outcomes for our learners.
 



  





 As a Program Associate, you will play a critical role in shaping the overall learner journey and ensuring the seamless execution of our flagship programs. This is a highly cross\-functional role that sits at the intersection of student experience, program operations, industry engagement, and stakeholder management.
 



  





 You will work closely with students, faculty, industry mentors, corporate partners, and internal teams to create an exceptional learning experience that goes far beyond the classroom. From managing learner engagement initiatives and campus experiences to coordinating industry immersions and strengthening corporate relationships, you will be instrumental in delivering the high\-quality outcomes that Digiaccel and Altera are known for.
 



  





 This role is ideal for individuals who thrive in fast\-paced environments, enjoy working with people, and are passionate about creating meaningful impact through education.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Learner Experience \& Community Building** 



* Act as a key touchpoint for students throughout their learning journey, ensuring a seamless and enriching experience.
* Foster a vibrant and engaging campus culture by driving student participation in clubs, events, competitions, and community initiatives.
* Design and execute initiatives that enhance learner engagement, satisfaction, and overall program experience.
* Regularly gather student feedback, identify improvement opportunities, and work with stakeholders to implement solutions.
* Build strong relationships with learners and create an environment that encourages collaboration, ownership, and professional growth.
* Monitor learner engagement and proactively address concerns to ensure a positive student experience.



**Program Delivery \& Operations Excellence** 



* Support the Program Director in executing academic and non\-academic aspects of the program.
* Coordinate with faculty, industry mentors, and internal teams to ensure smooth delivery of classes, workshops, projects, assessments and events.
* Manage program schedules, communications, logistics, and stakeholder coordination to ensure operational excellence.
* Track key milestones, deadlines, and deliverables to ensure a seamless learner experience.
* Continuously identify process improvements that enhance efficiency, scalability, and program quality.
* Ensure every learner\-facing interaction reflects the high standards of quality and professionalism associated with Digiaccel and Altera.



**Industry Engagement \& Corporate Partnerships** 



* Build and nurture relationships with industry leaders, hiring partners, mentors, and corporate stakeholders.
* Coordinate guest lectures, leadership talks, industry immersions, networking sessions, and experiential learning opportunities.
* Work closely with corporate partners to facilitate live projects, mentorship engagements, and industry collaborations.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen the institute's industry ecosystem and enhance learner exposure to real\-world business challenges.
* Represent Digiaccel and Altera professionally while building long\-term partnerships that create value for learners and industry stakeholders.



**Stakeholder Management \& Collaboration** 



* Collaborate closely with Academic Operations, Admissions, Marketing, Career Services, and Leadership teams to deliver a world\-class learner experience.
* Serve as a bridge between students, faculty, mentors, and corporate partners to ensure effective communication and alignment.
* Manage multiple stakeholders simultaneously while balancing competing priorities and timelines.
* Ensure prompt resolution of learner and stakeholder queries through proactive communication and coordination.



**Student Outcomes \& Continuous Improvement** 



* Contribute towards improving learner satisfaction, engagement, and program effectiveness.
* Track key learner experience metrics and provide insights to improve program delivery.
* Analyze feedback, engagement trends, and operational challenges to recommend actionable improvements.
* Support initiatives focused on strengthening learner outcomes, employability, and overall program impact.
* Continuously seek opportunities to innovate and elevate the student experience.



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* 1\-3\+ years of experience in Program Management, Operations, Community Management, Customer Success, Partnerships, Education, Events, or other stakeholder\-facing roles.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to build meaningful relationships across diverse stakeholder groups.
* Excellent organizational and project management capabilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.
* Strong ownership mindset with a proactive and solution\-oriented approach.
* Comfortable interacting with senior industry leaders, mentors, faculty, and students.
* Passion for education, learner success, and creating exceptional experiences.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and project management tools.
* A collaborative team player with a growth mindset and high attention to detail.



  





**Why Join Us?** 



* **Make a Tangible Impact** 
 : Your work will directly influence the learning journey, career outcomes, and professional growth of future business leaders.
* **Work at the Intersection of Education \& Industry:** 
 Collaborate with founders, CXOs, industry experts, and leading organizations that are shaping the future of business.
* **High Ownership, High Learning:** 
 Take ownership of critical initiatives from day one and gain exposure to multiple aspects of building and scaling a modern education institution.
* **Build the Future of Management Education:** 
 Be part of a mission\-driven organization that is redefining how business education is delivered in a digital and AI first world.
* **Accelerated Career Growth** 
 : Work in a talent\-dense environment where performance, initiative, and impact are recognized and rewarded with greater responsibility and growth opportunities.



  





**About the Company** 




 Digiaccel Learning is a Gurgaon headquartered education company that is redefining the gold standard of management education for the digital and AI first world. By doing so, it is building the next generation of business leaders in the country. The mission of the company is to build employability through education.
 



  





 Education is a hard and important problem to solve for. India needs to double its higher education infrastructure in order to serve its large demographic of youth. Within what exists, quality is a large problem with studies reporting that 50% of Indian graduates are unemployable. Add to this the shift in the skills ecosystem at the workplace with AI and digitization. All of this has led to a higher\-education infrastructure that is unable to serve the aspirations of its students. So, you have MBA students from legacy institutes who are unplaced and professionals who are struggling to level up in their careers because they don’t have the skills to progress.
 



  





 The secret sauce at the company is its instructional design, a learner centric ethos and a bar for quality that runs across touchpoints. This reflects in a 80%\+ NPS across all programs since inception.
 



  





 Digiaccel Learning is VC backed and has CXOs and Founders of some of India’s top digital commerce companies as it’s investors.
 



  





 We are looking for smart passionate folks to join us in this mission of building a better, smarter and more outcome oriented education system. We are a young company and each role has the ability to make a large impact. We can assure of a very talent dense, intellectually honest, action oriented and collaborative environment.
 



  





 We are sure that you will join for the opportunity and stay for the impact of seeing your work help thousands of others.

title: Senior Design Manager: Sheet Metal
description:
**Job Title: Senior Design Manager** 




**Location: Gurgaon, Haryana, India** 




**Experience: Minimum 15 years overall; 7\+ years in leadership** 




**Working Days\- Monday\-Saturday** 




**Employment Type: Full\-time** 




  





**Role summary** 




 We are seeking a seasoned Senior Design Manager with deep expertise in SolidWorks and Production line experience in Sheet Metal. You will lead design projects from concept through validation, mentor engineers, enforce design\-for\-manufacturability and cost‑efficiency, and drive continuous improvement in processes and tools. The role requires strong technical judgment, excellent stakeholder management, and hands\-on involvement in complex sheet‑metal product development.
 



  





**Key accountabilities\-** 




**\- Team leadership and people management** 




 \- Recruit, develop, retain, and scale a high\-performing design team (mechanical engineers, CAD leads, drafters).
 



 \- Establish clear role descriptions, career ladders, KPIs, and individual development plans.
 



 \- Conduct regular 1:1s, performance reviews, succession planning, and calibration with HR and senior leadership.
 



 \- Promote a culture of ownership, continuous learning, safety, and cross\-functional collaboration.
 



  





**\- Technical ownership and hands\-on design** 




 \- Provide hands\-on SolidWorks leadership for complex sheet‑metal parts and assemblies; create and review 3D models, flat patterns, BOMs, and manufacturing drawings.
 



 \- Set and enforce CAD modeling standards, naming conventions, feature suppression strategies, and template libraries.
 



 \- Approve final CAD deliverables for prototype release and production release; maintain as‑built documentation.
 



  





 \-
 **Product development lifecycle \& project leadership** 




 \- Drive design phases: conceptualization, feasibility, prototyping, verification, pilot production, and full\-scale production.
 



 \- Define design milestones, gate criteria, quality checkpoints, and deliverables (DFMEA, test plans, validation matrices).
 



 \- Lead cross\-functional Design Reviews (DRs) and Gate Reviews; present technical trade\-offs and risk mitigation plans to stakeholders.
 



  





**\- Manufacturability, cost optimization \& supplier engineering** 




 \- Own DFMA for sheet‑metal: material selection, blank size optimization, bend allowances, nesting strategies, common parts, and fastener selection.
 



 \- Collaborate with toolrooms and suppliers on tooling design (dies, progressive tooling, fixtures), vendor capabilities, and lead\-time management.
 



 \- Drive cost\-down initiatives through design simplification, standardization, and volume\-based sourcing strategies.
 



  





**\- Quality, compliance \& reliability** 




 \- Ensure designs meet applicable standards (safety, EMC, environmental) and internal quality requirements.
 



 \- Lead root cause analysis (8D) for field failures involving mechanical design; drive corrective \& preventive actions.
 



 \- Oversee validation plans: structural testing, fatigue, vibration, thermal, and ingress protection as required.
 



  





**\- Process improvement \& systems** 




 \- Implement and mature CAD/PDM/PLM workflows (SolidWorks PDM/Manage, Teamcenter, Windchill), change control (ECO), and revision management.
 



 \- Champion automation: design tables, macros, templates, configurators, and model\-based definition (MBD) where applicable.
 



 \- Institutionalize best practices: design reuse libraries, standard parts catalogs, and knowledge\-sharing sessions.
 



  





**\- Stakeholder management \& reporting** 




 \- Work closely with Product Management, Manufacturing, Procurement, QA, and Program Management to align schedules, costs, and requirements.
 



 \- Produce regular reports on design progress, risks, resource utilization, and cost metrics to senior leadership.
 



 \- Represent the design function in supplier selection, audits, and escalation meetings.
 



  





**Deliverables \& success metrics** 




**\- Deliverables** 




 \- Complete CAD packages (models, flat patterns, drawings, BOMs) for prototypes and production.
 



 \- DFMEA, tolerance stack\-ups, verification \& validation plans, prototype test reports.
 



 \- Design standard documentation, CAD libraries, and training materials.
 



  





**Required qualifications \& experience (expanded)** 




**\- Education:** 
 B.Tech/B.E. in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent; M.Tech/M.S. preferred.
 



**\- Experience:** 
 Minimum 15 years in mechanical/product design with heavy emphasis on sheet‑metal; at least 7 years in a managerial or lead capacity.
 



**\- CAD skills** 
 : Expert\-level SolidWorks (modeling, sheet‑metal module, assemblies, weldments, routing optional), experience with SolidWorks PDM/Manage or equivalent.
 



**\- Manufacturing knowledge:** 
 Thorough understanding of sheet‑metal fabrication processes (laser, plasma, punching, bending, progressive forming), welding, adhesive joining, rivets, fastening, surface treatments, and finish processes.
 



**\- Systems:** 
 Hands\-on experience with PLM/PDM systems, ECO workflows, BOM management, and basic ERP interactions.
 



**\- Process skills** 
 : DFMA, GD\&T, tolerance analysis, DFMEA, root cause analysis tools (8D, RCA), and test plan development.
 



 \-
 **Leadership:** 
 Demonstrated people management, hiring, mentoring, and stakeholder negotiation experience.
 



 \-
 **Communication** 
 : Strong written and verbal English; ability to present technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.
 



 \-
 **Mobility:** 
 Willingness to travel domestically and internationally to suppliers and production sites (as required).
 



  





**Preferred / differentiating skills** 




 \-
 **Certifications:** 
 CSWP/CSWE, Six Sigma Green/Black Belt, PMP or equivalent.
 



 \-
 **Domain experience** 
 : Automotive, industrial machinery, telecom enclosures, medical devices, appliances, or defense.
 



 \-
 **Simulation:** 
 Experience with sheet‑metal forming simulation (e.g., AutoForm), FEA for stamped parts, topology optimization.
 



 \-
 **Tooling \& fixtures:** 
 Prior experience designing jigs, fixtures, and progressive dies.
 



 \-
 **Software:** 
 Exposure to CAM, nesting software, NestMaster, Lantek, RADAN or similar.
 



 \-
 **Manufacturing exposure:** 
 Experience working with contract manufacturers and international supply chains.
 



 Interested candidates can share their resume at 8750604449\-Harshita Joshi or at payal@metaguise.com

title: Commercial & Transformation Lead
description:
**Mission Brief** 




  





 Transform how Lenskart buys, negotiates and creates value from every rupee it spends.
 



 Lenskart is scaling rapidly across manufacturing, retail, supply chain and multiple geographies. At this scale, commercial decisions are no longer just about procurement. They are a strategic lever for growth, margin and competitive advantage.
 



 The opportunity is to bring greater intelligence, discipline and technology into how we manage external spend, from manufacturing inputs and logistics to retail, technology and corporate categories.
 



 Your mandate is to close the gap between what we spend and what we should spend and create a commercial engine that is data\-led, AI\-enabled and deeply connected to the business.
 



 This is a high\-ownership role for someone who enjoys solving complex, ambiguous business problems and turning those solutions into measurable outcomes.
 



  





**What You Will Own:** 




  





 Commercial Intelligence \& AI
 



 Shape Lenskart’s commercial intelligence layer across:
 


* Spend analytics, should\-cost models and total\-cost\-of\-ownership frameworks
* Supplier intelligence, scorecards and risk assessment
* E\-sourcing and contract intelligence
* AI\-assisted negotiation and price discovery
* Automated, data\-led decision making across categories



  





 The goal is to move from fragmented information and manual decision\-making to a system where
 **the data tells us where the opportunity is and technology helps us act on it.** 




  





 Strategic Sourcing \& P\&L Impact
 



 Own the commercial opportunity across a broad spend universe:
 



**Direct:** 
 Frames, lenses, coatings, accessories, packaging and manufacturing inputs
 



**Indirect:** 
 Store CapEx and OpEx, marketing, technology and corporate spend
 



**Supply Chain:** 
 Logistics, last\-mile, lab\-to\-store, make\-vs\-buy and network optimisation
 



 You will be expected to identify structural opportunities, develop category strategies and deliver measurable YoY P\&L impact through
 **should\-cost, TCO, value engineering and smarter commercial models.** 




  





 Negotiation \& Supplier Strategy
 



 Lead some of Lenskart’s highest\-value commercial negotiations while establishing greater negotiation rigour across the organisation.
 



  





 This includes developing stronger supplier strategies, benchmarking markets, understanding cost structures, defining negotiation playbooks and creating clear walk\-away positions.
 



 The objective is not simply to
 **negotiate harder** 
 , but to fundamentally improve the economics of the relationships we enter into.
 



  





 Business Problem Solving \& Leadership
 



 This role sits at the intersection of multiple parts of the business.
 



 You will work closely with
 **Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Retail, Technology and Marketing** 
 , as well as the founders and senior leadership team, on problems where the answer is not always obvious.
 



  





 You will be expected to:
 


* Break down complex business problems into clear commercial decisions.
* Challenge existing ways of working using data and first\-principles thinking.
* Translate business requirements into technology and AI solutions.
* Take ideas from analysis through implementation and measurable impact.
* Influence stakeholders across functions and drive adoption at scale.



  





 Who We’re Looking For
 



 We are looking for someone who
 **thinks like a business leader, not a functional specialist.** 




 You may come from strategy, consulting, business operations, supply chain, sourcing, procurement, corporate development or a high\-growth operating environment.
 



 What matters is that you have demonstrated:
 


* Strong problem\-solving ability across ambiguous, high\-impact business situations.
* Experience working directly with founders or senior leadership.
* Strong commercial and analytical instincts.
* Exposure to supply chain, sourcing, cost structures or commercial strategy.
* The ability to connect
 **strategy, economics, technology and execution.**
* A track record of taking ownership for outcomes, not just recommendations.
* Curiosity and instinct to use AI and technology to fundamentally improve how work gets done.



 Experience with
 **manufacturing, APAC, China or Middle East supply ecosystems** 
 is a strong advantage.
 



  





 Why This Role
 



**This is not a traditional procurement role.** 




 You will have the opportunity to work on some of the most consequential commercial problems at Lenskart, with visibility into the decisions that shape
 **margin, supply chain, capital allocation and growth.** 




  





 You will work closely with the
 **founders and senior leadership** 
 , operate across the full business and have significant ownership over the direction of the commercial function.
 



 The scale is substantial:
 **2,500\+ stores, hundreds of suppliers, multiple geographies and an increasingly complex manufacturing and supply chain ecosystem.** 




  





 The opportunity is to combine
 **business problem solving, commercial strategy, supply chain thinking and technology** 
 to create a capability that can materially change Lenskart’s economics.

* Customer\-first mindset with a bias for quick problem resolution.
* Working knowledge of Delhi NCR geography, traffic patterns, and transport hubs is a strong advantage.
* Willingness to work in shifts, be on\-ground, and be reachable during operational hours.

**Why Join Flix**
 At Flix, we empower our teams to push boundaries and shape the future of mobility. As we continue to scale globally, we harness cutting\-edge technology to make mobility smarter, more sustainable, and more affordable.

description:
**Role Title: AVP, Collections Specialized Strategy (L10\)**
**Company Overview**
 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
   

  

**Organizational Overview**
 Credit Team decisions credit actions across the lifecycle of a customer – from acquisition to account management to collections and recover – we work towards managing credit and fraud losses and elevating customer experience through powerful and proprietary insights on customer risk and credit behaviors. The actionable insights are driven by access to numerous alternative data sources, new age technologies, focused strategies, emerging algorithms, and predictive precision. Spread across 10 pillars the credit team in India caters to the entire gamut of decision sciences, from data management to model development to strategy design, and bringing it all to life through technology, and managing within the guardrails of our regulatory requirements. As part of the team, you will have access to some unique product propositions, functional and leadership training, interaction with executive leadership team and a myriad of diverse perspectives.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 This role will be responsible for Collections Strategy analytics to generate insights in strategy development, implementation, and performance monitoring of complex, regulatory\-sensitive loss mitigation programs. The person in this role will participate in the design of challenger (test) strategies including eligibility criteria, opportunity sizing, performance monitoring, and on\-going strategy enhancement. The creation and delivery of presentations to cross functional audiences is essential. In addition, there is on\-going responsibilities for maintaining key performance reporting and strategy documentation.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own loss mitigation program reporting and analytics: Create materials and lead monthly presentation to Collections Leadership. Create required quarterly OCC loss mitigation volume and performance presentation slides. Interpret performance and clearly present findings.
* Drive automation and perform ongoing validation/maintenance of new and existing loss mitigation reports; create automated reports with interactive data visualization intelligence.
* Proactively drive visual and content enhancements to loss mitigation program reporting for volumes and performance (e.g. advanced filters for due stage, channel, client, plan type, plan duration etc.).
* Support strategic initiatives by researching industry best practices, analyzing market trends, and identifying opportunities to strengthen pre\-charge\-off loss mitigation efforts.
* Partner with multiple groups to implement reporting changes and assess post\-implementation execution and performance.
* Proactively communicate and engage across multiple levels, on the status of project progress and analytic priorities
* Lead loss mitigation strategy changes for required maintenance (e.g., NCI/NPI; MISC1 changes; regulatory updates). This includes obtaining Working Group and Tollgate approvals, strategy sheet updates, requests to Strategy Delivery, and tracking pre \& post implementation validations (if applicable).
* Support in transitioning all existing and future loss mitigation strategy test performance monitoring to the Growth team
* Provide Analytics support to build best in class strategies for Loss Mitigation programs
* Evaluate new data elements, sources, industry best practices for collections
* Co\-lead or support cross\-functional project teams to consistently track performance. Perform analytics to understand performance changes and make enhancements to address degradation.
* Support OCC, Audit, NMT accuracy requests, regulatory requirements for all loss mitigation programs and ensure strategy documentation is comprehensive, accurate and up to date (i.e., audit ready).
* Participate in ad\-hoc projects and analyses, as needed, Other duties as assigned.


**Required Skills/Knowledge**
* Bachelor's degree with quantitative underpinning (i.e., Data Science, Computer Science, Risk, Accounting, Business, Economics, Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering) with 4\+ years of experience in Programming/Analytics ideally in support of Risk, Credit, Finance, Consumer Lending, or other relevant professional experience; OR in lieu of a degree, 6\+ years of experience in Programming/Analytics ideally in support of Risk, Credit, Finance, Accounting, Consumer Lending, or other relevant professional experience.
* 4\+ years’ experience in SAS, SQL, Excel, Word and PowerPoint
* Excellent interpersonal, analytical, organizational and written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to make decisions and recommendations based on quantitative analysis and creative thinking
* Strong self\-starter balanced with desire to achieve team goals
* Ability to handle sensitive issues with uncompromising integrity and confidentiality


**Desired Skills/Knowledge**
* Prior Collection Strategy Development or Credit Strategy Development/ Risk Management experience and/or prior Collections experience in other functions
* 4\+ years demonstrated success developing and delivering advanced analytics solutions
* Data lake experience and strategies
* Master's degree in Business or in a Quantitative Related Field
* Proven analytical and decision\-making skills
* Experience developing scoring models or decision\-tree segmentations
* Ability to independently manage processes, Self\-motivated, and drive continuous process improvement
* Strong communications, problem solving skills and attention to detail
* Experience presenting to senior leadership teams
* Demonstrated ability to apply strategic thinking toward tactical execution
* Experience working with cross\-functional project teams


**Eligibility Criteria**
* Bachelor's degree with quantitative underpinning (i.e., Data Science, Computer Science, Risk, Accounting, Business, Economics, Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering) with 4\+ years of experience in Programming/Analytics ideally in support of Risk, Credit, Finance, Accounting, Consumer Lending, or other relevant professional experience; OR in lieu of a degree, 6\+ years of experience in Programming/Analytics ideally in support of Risk, Credit, Finance, Accounting, Consumer Lending, or other relevant professional experience.


**Work Timings:**

This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs) We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony.  Own the end\-to\-end delivery of event design and decor projects, translating creative briefs into executable plans, controlled production, and flawless on\-site outcomes. You will connect design, fabrication, vendors, logistics, clients, and installation teams so every element is delivered to specification, on time, within agreed budgets, and in line with venue and safety requirements. The role combines planning discipline with creative judgment and requires regular workshop checks, client meetings, site visits, pre\-event reviews, installations, and dismantling. Based in Gurugram, you will work full\-time with Sunday as the weekly day off and other Saturdays generally working. Standard timings are 9:00 AM to 7:30 PM Dubai time, with occasional extended hours during event builds or urgent project phases. Additional hours or weekend work will be managed through compensatory time or schedule adjustments according to company policy.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Convert creative briefs into practical decor execution plans, production schedules, resource lists, installation timelines, and clear deliverables that keep design, production, and logistics teams aligned.
* Own vendor, fabricator, and supplier coordination by sourcing capable partners, negotiating requirements, tracking procurement, and securing reliable delivery of materials, props, and finished decor elements.
* Maintain an accurate vendor tracker covering quality, pricing, capacity, and reliability so project decisions improve supplier performance, reduce execution risk, and support consistent delivery standards.
* Control production progress through workshop visits, quality checks, pre\-event meetings, issue resolution, and specification reviews that protect creative intent, safety, timelines, and client expectations.
* Lead venue installation and dismantling, allocate manpower and resources, and resolve last\-minute site challenges so event spaces are completed safely, professionally, and ready for successful delivery.
* Serve as the decor execution contact for clients and internal stakeholders, contributing technical input during meetings and site visits while ensuring agreed standards, budgets, and approvals remain controlled.
* Maintain complete project records, including budgets, contracts, design approvals, schedules, and compliance documentation, while supporting the vetting of new vendors and freelance execution partners.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* Demonstrated project management capability across event design and decor execution, with the judgment to convert creative direction into controlled plans, production milestones, and measurable delivery outcomes.
* Strong vendor and production management skills, including sourcing, negotiation, procurement coordination, workshop quality checks, material knowledge, fabrication awareness, and supplier performance tracking.
* Practical on\-site execution expertise, including installation, dismantling, manpower allocation, venue coordination, safety compliance, and calm resolution of urgent or changing event requirements.
* Clear communication and stakeholder coordination skills for working with clients, designers, production teams, logistics partners, fabricators, freelancers, and diverse on\-ground crews.
* Proficiency with Excel, Google Sheets, Asana, Trello, Monday.com, Google Drive, SharePoint, OneDrive, Google Calendar, Outlook, Canva, PowerPoint, or Adobe Acrobat for planning and documentation.
* Strong attention to detail, creative problem\-solving ability, and the resilience to manage multiple vendors, deadlines, approvals, and project priorities during high\-pressure event periods.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* Experience delivering premium client events, high\-profile celebrations, corporate functions, product launches, weddings, galas, or other complex bespoke experiences is advantageous.
* A strong portfolio demonstrating successful event decor projects, practical design understanding, and consistent control of production quality will be valued.
* Experience with leading event design and decor agencies or comparable high\-volume production environments will be considered an advantage.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* 4–6 years of project management experience focused on event design, decor production, fabrication, or on\-ground event execution, supported by examples of work delivered from brief through installation.
* A Bachelor's degree in Event Management, Design, Architecture, or a related discipline is preferred; equivalent hands\-on experience with a strong portfolio will also be considered.
* You bring structured planning, commercial awareness, supplier judgment, and a sharp eye for detail, enabling creative concepts to become practical, safe, high\-quality environments within agreed budgets and timelines.
* You communicate confidently with premium clients, vendors, fabricators, designers, logistics teams, and site crews, while remaining composed when requirements shift or execution pressure increases.
* You are comfortable working from Gurugram, attending workshops, client meetings, and site visits, and taking ownership of installations, dismantling, documentation, and delivery\-critical decisions.
* You are willing to work extended hours during event builds or urgent project phases, with additional hours or weekend work offset through compensatory time or schedule adjustments under company policy.



  





**Why Join Us** 



* Own work that is visible, tangible, and commercially important, with direct responsibility for turning ambitious creative concepts into memorable environments that clients and guests experience firsthand.
* Work across the full event delivery chain, from creative interpretation and supplier selection through fabrication, quality control, installation, and dismantling, building deep expertise in bespoke event execution.
* Join a hands\-on team that values creativity, excellence, precision, professionalism, and attention to detail, where strong operational judgment directly improves the quality and reliability of every event.
* Self\-motivated candidates will find meaningful opportunities to grow by taking ownership of increasingly complex projects, strengthening client and vendor relationships, and expanding their influence across the event delivery operation.
* Develop relationships with designers, fabricators, vendors, clients, and event professionals while managing varied projects across weddings, galas, celebrations, corporate functions, and product launches.
* Receive competitive compensation and a practical working arrangement that recognizes additional event\-period demands through compensatory time or schedule adjustments in line with company policy.



  





**What We Offer** 



* Competitive compensation aligned with the scope of ownership, event execution expertise, portfolio quality, and experience managing complex decor projects.
* Full\-time ownership of varied event design and decor assignments, with exposure to creative planning, vendor ecosystems, fabrication, client coordination, and large\-scale on\-ground delivery.
* A structured working arrangement with Sunday as the weekly day off, while additional event\-period hours are managed through compensatory time or schedule adjustments under company policy.

We believe everyone deserves exceptional craftsmanship and timeless design without the traditional markups. title: Engineering Manager, AI Builder Experience
description:
AI frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, and n8n are quickly becoming the default way developers build with AI — and MongoDB wants to be the data platform that shows up everywhere they build. As part of the AI Builders Experience org at MongoDB, we’re forming a brand new engineering team to make that happen, and we're looking for the founding Engineering Manager to hire the team, set the technical direction, and ship integrations into some of the fastest\-moving open\-source ecosystems in tech.
   

  

 In this role, you'll be close enough to the code to jump into exploratory work yourself while also building the team, process, and operational rigor to keep a growing integration portfolio healthy long\-term. The new team will work mostly in Python and TypeScript while collaborating closely with client library teams and other engineering groups across MongoDB that deliver the underlying driver, platform, and product capabilities needed to support these integrations well.
   

  

 You’ll collaborate closely and move quickly with product, partners, field teams, the developer community, and open source project maintainers to ship where demand is real, deepen investment where adoption proves out, and evolve the portfolio over time as it becomes a critical part of MongoDB’s future in AI.
   

  

 MongoDB engineering teams pride themselves on building high\-quality software and living our values every day. We value intellectual curiosity, intellectual honesty, customer empathy, and building together in an environment that prioritizes collaboration over competition.
   

  

 We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
   

  

 Position expectations
   

  

* Work closely with recruiting to hire a team of Python and TypeScript engineers who will build and own MongoDB integrations across a broad AI framework ecosystem that includes technologies like Langchain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, n8n, and Mastra
* Execute effectively in a fast\-moving environment where priorities may shift week to week based on framework changes, customer demand, partner needs, and strategic opportunity. Deliver quickly while keeping a high standard of technical quality
* Flag issues, concerns, and resource needs early, working with management to triage, staff, borrow expertise, and cross\-functionally hand off completed projects as needed
* Work closely with product managers, program managers, sales, GTM, and peer engineering teams to define, prioritize, and deliver capabilities that improve the builder experience and strengthen MongoDB’s position in the AI framework ecosystem; help decide where to invest effort and where to pull back
* Manage dependencies on drivers, platform capabilities, and other MongoDB product surfaces required to deliver excellent framework integrations
* Collaborate with external teams who own open source projects MongoDB integrates with, maintaining a high standard of professionalism and courtesy to work effectively through external maintainer review cycles to land high\-quality upstream contributions
* Jump in to do initial, exploratory work. Guide key decisions, unblock the team, and contribute when needed as projects grow
* Own the monitoring, operations, maintenance, and ongoing quality of a broad, evolving integration portfolio; develop testing strategy, release readiness, and operational follow\-through after launch
* Help the team build and maintain sustainable engineering practices, including CI/CD, automated testing, version compatibility awareness, and strong integration health over time
* Develop a team that stays current with the Python, TypeScript, and broader AI builder ecosystems, including important frameworks, community discussions, and emerging patterns; maintain awareness of trends and discourse in contemporary AI
* Bring a research and discovery mindset to the role, using customer, community, partner, and field signals to help guide roadmap and investment decisions; identify emerging opportunities in the ecosystem and help decide where early investment could create strategic advantage


**Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of experience building developer platforms, libraries, or other high\-scale technical systems, with strong proficiency in Python or TypeScript and an ability to lead teams working across both the Python and TypeScript ecosystems. Experience working with programming language polyglot teams is a plus
* 3\+ years of experience managing a team of software engineers and providing technical leadership for complex projects or products
* Experience with query optimization (especially MongoDB) and AI coding tools; distributed systems experience would be an asset
* Demonstrated success hiring, mentoring, and growing high\-performing engineering teams, including experience supporting career development, feedback, and performance management
* Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in a fast\-moving technical landscape with frequent context switching, incomplete information, and competing opportunities, while maintaining sound prioritization and strong judgment
* Strong technical depth in developer\-facing software, with the judgment to make and guide architectural trade\-offs
* Experience leading the launch of new features or systems and operating them successfully in production after release
* Excellent written and verbal technical communication, with a strong instinct to collaborate across engineering, product, and other stakeholder groups
* A track record of escalating issues early and fostering a team culture that values intellectual honesty and collaboration
