title: Senior Enterprise Solutions Manager - Brand & Engagement
description:
**💻 Position: Senior Enterprise Solutions Manager \- Brand \& Engagement** 




**📍Location: Delhi** 




**🗓️ Working Days: Monday to Friday** 




**📌 Experience Required: 4–7 years** 




  





**About the Role** 




 Own the
 **end\-to\-end implementation and growth of FMCG brand campaigns post\-sale** 
 — getting them live, setting up tooling/dashboards, handling SQL, legal/ops, and building solutions when standard processes don’t fit.
 



  





**The Role** 



* You own what happens after a brand signs — and part of what happens just before.
* You take a signed (or near\-signed) enterprise brand and stand up a working, measurable campaign: configuring internal tooling, building the demo/sandbox the brand evaluates, wiring up their analytics dashboards, and clearing the legal and operational steps between contract and go\-live.
* When the standard path doesn't fit a brand's ask, you design one. And you feed every recurring gap back to Product, so the next deployment is faster.
* This is a builder's seat, not a relationship\-management seat. You'll be measured on getting brands live, instrumented and expanding — not on meeting cadence.



  





**What You'll Do** 



* **Demos \& sandboxes:** 
 Build the demo environments and proof\-of\-concept setups brands evaluate, in coordination with the founding team.
* **Solutioning:** 
 Translate a brand's objective into a concrete campaign configuration. Invent workarounds when our defaults don't fit.
* **Customer setup:** 
 Configure and launch new enterprise customers in our internal tools. Own time\-to\-first\-live\-campaign.
* **Analytics:** 
 Stand up and maintain customer\-facing dashboards so every brand can see purchase intent and campaign outcomes without having to ask.
* **Cross\-functional coordination:** 
 Drive legal (MSAs, DPAs, brand \& procurement reviews) and operations (fulfilment, sampling logistics) to unblock go\-live.
* **Account outcomes:** 
 Own the ongoing result — accounts that stay live and grow because they're properly instrumented. Catch risk in the data before it surfaces at renewal, not after.
* **Product partnership:** 
 Surface recurring friction, scope it with Product, and help shape the tooling built specifically for this function.



  





**Requirements** 



* 4–7 years in solutions engineering, implementation / onboarding, technical account management, or enterprise customer success at a B2B SaaS, martech or adtech company.
* Hands\-on data fluency. You build dashboards from raw data, not just read them — hands\-on SQL, plus a BI tool (Metabase, Looker, Power BI, Tableau).
* Ownership in ambiguity. You've run an implementation or a complex onboarding end\-to\-end, not just managed a relationship around one.
* Enterprise stakeholder management. You've sat across from brand / marketing, procurement and legal — ideally in or around FMCG / CPG brand teams or their agencies (WPP, Publicis, Mindshare, Dentsu).
* Communication. Sharp written and verbal; you can run a room of senior client stakeholders.

description:

 Government eMarketplace (GeM) is a unified digital platform that facilitates end\-to\-end procurement of goods and services
 



 by various government departments, organizations, and public sector undertakings (PSUs). Our Honourable Prime Minister’s concerted efforts to harness the power of digital platforms to achieve ‘Minimum Government, Maximum Governance’ led to the genesis of GeM in 2016\.
 



  





 GeM provides a paperless, cashless and contactless ecosystem for government buyers to directly purchase products and services from pan\-India sellers and service providers through an online platform. GeM covers the entire gamut of procurement process, right from vendor registration and item selection by buyers to receipt of goods and facilitation of timely payments. GeM has envisioned to utilise the agility and speed that come alongwith a digital platform createdwith a strategic intent to reinvigorate public procurement systems and bring about a lasting change for the underserved as well as the nation.
 



  





 Built on the pillars of Efficiency, Transparency and Inclusivity, GeM has emerged as a digital tool in nation’s interest, aimed at catalyzing excellence in public procurement. To know more about us, please visit\- https://gem.gov.in/
 



  





 You may also followus on social media platforms like – Twitter,LinkedIn, Koo App, YouTube, Facebook

title: CRM & Business Systems Architect
description:
Company Description
 
  





 E\-Waste Recyclers India (EWRI) is one of India’s established e\-waste recycling and IT Asset Disposition (ITAD) companies, with nearly 18 years of industry experience. As a women\-led, R2v3\-certified organization, EWRI provides secure, compliant, and sustainable technology lifecycle solutions across India.
 



 EWRI serves 5,000\+ clients, including global enterprises, OEMs, institutions, government organizations, and international ITAD and recycling partners requiring execution across India.
 



 With 50,000\+ MT of combined processing capacity, our capabilities span ITAD, secure data sanitization and destruction, data center decommissioning, refurbishment and reuse, asset recovery and remarketing, e\-waste recycling, plastics recovery, and battery recycling.
 



 As EWRI continues to scale, we are investing in technology\-driven traceability, automation, operational visibility, and customer reporting across the entire IT asset disposition process.
 


 About the Role
 
  





 EWRI is looking for an experienced
 **CRM \& Business Systems Architect** 
 to help us design the digital foundation for our next stage of growth.
 



 This is a business\-process and solution\-architecture role. We have
 **not pre\-selected a CRM or technology platform** 
 . The successful candidate will work directly with management and internal teams to understand how our business operates, map current and future requirements, evaluate suitable technology platforms, and recommend the right architecture for EWRI.
 



 The initial focus will be designing and implementing a scalable CRM covering sales, customer relationships, business development, international partnerships, direct outreach, asset sourcing, and auction opportunities.
 



 The system will subsequently need to integrate with or expand into ITAD project management, pickups and logistics, asset tracking, data security, inventory, refurbishment, remarketing, recycling, reporting, field operations, and customer\-facing portals.
 



 The objective is to create a connected business operating platform rather than implement a standalone CRM.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 
  




* Work directly with management and internal teams to understand, map, and document existing business processes.
* Conduct structured requirements\-gathering sessions across sales, operations, logistics, finance, warehouse, ITAD, and management teams.
* Map current\-state workflows and design scalable future\-state processes.
* Identify inefficiencies, manual processes, duplicated data, and opportunities for automation.
* Define the functional and technical requirements for EWRI's CRM.
* Design workflows for accounts, contacts, leads, opportunities, direct outreach, quotations, follow\-ups, approvals, partner management, and customer relationships.
* Design requirements for international ITAD partner development and onboarding.
* Design workflows for direct asset sourcing, supplier opportunities, inventory offers, and auction tracking.
* Evaluate suitable CRM, ERP, low\-code, and business application platforms based on EWRI's requirements.
* Compare platforms based on functionality, scalability, customization, integration capabilities, security, user experience, implementation complexity, and total cost of ownership.
* Recommend the appropriate technology stack and implementation architecture.
* Design the integration between CRM and future ITAD operational systems.
* Define data structures, workflows, automation rules, user roles, permissions, audit trails, dashboards, and reporting requirements.
* Develop detailed functional specifications and implementation documentation.
* Work closely with developers and/or implementation partners during development.
* Review development to ensure the system aligns with approved business processes and architecture.
* Lead or support UAT, deployment planning, employee training, and user adoption.
* Establish a long\-term roadmap for extending the platform into ITAD operations and other business functions.


 Future System Scope
 
  





 The architecture should be capable of supporting future modules including:
 


* ITAD project and site management
* Pickup and logistics management
* Asset and serial\-number tracking
* Data sanitization and destruction
* Field technician/mobile workflows
* Chain\-of\-custody tracking
* Exception management
* Automated reports and certificates
* Warehouse and inventory management
* Refurbishment and grading
* Asset recovery and remarketing
* Recycling and downstream tracking
* Customer and international partner portals
* Financial reconciliation and project profitability
* Management dashboards and business intelligence


 Required Skills \& Experience
 
  




* CRM and/or ERP solution architecture
* Business process mapping and process redesign
* Requirements gathering and functional specification
* CRM implementation and configuration
* Data architecture and workflow design
* Business process automation
* API and third\-party integrations
* User roles, permissions, security, and governance
* Reporting, dashboards, and business intelligence
* UAT, deployment, and user adoption
* Experience working directly with business users and senior management
* Experience taking business applications from discovery through implementation



 Experience with multiple platforms such as
 **Microsoft Dynamics 365, Microsoft Power Platform, Salesforce, Odoo, Zoho, HubSpot, SAP, or similar enterprise business systems** 
 will be highly valued.
 



 The candidate should be capable of evaluating technologies objectively rather than being dependent on a single platform.
 


 What We're Looking For
 
  





 We are looking for someone who thinks
 **business process first and software second** 
 .
 



 The successful candidate should be comfortable sitting with our teams and observing how work actually happens — from a customer enquiry or outbound approach through quotation, project execution, asset processing, reporting, and commercial closure.
 



 We want someone capable of asking the right questions, challenging inefficient processes, identifying what should and should not be automated, and translating the resulting requirements into a scalable system architecture.
 



 The ideal candidate has previously been involved in the complete lifecycle:
 



**Business Discovery → Process Mapping → Requirements Gathering → Platform Evaluation → Solution Architecture → Implementation → Testing/UAT → Deployment → User Adoption → Continuous Improvement** 




**Experience: 3\+ years preferred.** 



 Initial Assignment
 
  





 The first phase will be to:
 


1. Understand and document EWRI's existing processes.
2. Define our future\-state workflows.
3. Develop detailed CRM requirements.
4. Evaluate suitable technology platforms.
5. Recommend the appropriate platform and architecture.
6. Define implementation costs, resources, risks, and timeline.
7. Develop a phased implementation roadmap.
8. Support the implementation of the selected solution.



 This is an opportunity to help design a business operating platform from the ground up and play a key role in EWRI's long\-term digital transformation as we scale our ITAD, refurbishment, recycling, and technology lifecycle operations across India and internationally.

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
**About the role**




 We are looking for a highly detail\-oriented, execution\-focused, and analytically strong Project Manager to join our online market research operations team. This role is central to the successful delivery of quantitative research studies across global markets, predominantly the US, UK, and international B2B/B2C ecosystems.
 



 The ideal candidate should possess strong end\-to\-end ownership capabilities across project execution, client servicing, scripting coordination, sample management, data quality validation, and reporting workflows. This is not a coordination\-only role — we are looking for someone who understands the operational, logical, and analytical nuances of online research and can proactively drive projects with speed, accountability, and precision.
 



 The role demands high agility, strong multi\-tasking ability, operational maturity, and comfort working in a fast\-paced environment handling multiple concurrent studies with strict timelines.
 



  





**Role\- Senior Project Manager (Online Market Research Operations)** 




**Location\- Gurugram (Work from Office)** 




  





**Key Responsibilities**




  





**End\-to End Project Ownership** 



* Independently manage the complete lifecycle of quantitative online research projects from kickoff to final delivery.
* Ensure projects are launched, monitored, validated, and delivered within timelines while adhering to client requirements and internal quality standards.
* Maintain complete ownership of project execution including timelines, feasibility alignment, scripting coordination, field management, quotas, data checks, tabulation planning, and reporting coordination.
* Drive proactive communication internally and externally throughout all project phases.



**Client Servicing \& Stakeholder Management** 



* Serve as the primary operational point of contact for clients during active project execution.
* Interpret client objectives, research intent, questionnaire requirements, and reporting expectations accurately.
* Ensure timely acknowledgement and resolution of client requests, revisions, and escalations.
* Build confidence with clients through responsiveness, attention to detail, consultative thinking, and execution reliability.



**Questionnaire Review \& Research Logic Understanding** 



* Review questionnaires thoroughly for logic consistency, research flow, respondent experience, and data quality implications before scripting.
* Possess strong understanding of:
* Complex skip logic
* Piping and randomization
* Rotations and masking
* Quota structures
* Validation conditions
* Multi\-level logic dependencies
* Mobile optimization
* Grid optimization
* Conjoint and MaxDiff structures
* Brand lists and segmentation frameworks
* Identify gaps, contradictions, or potential respondent biases proactively before launch.



**Scripting Coordination \& Survey Validation** 



* Work closely with Survey Programming teams and possess operational exposure to platforms such as Decipher and related survey ecosystems.
* Coordinate testing and validation for:
* Survey logic
* Quota controls
* Redirects
* URL parameters
* API variables
* Security checks
* Device compatibility
* Open\-end validations
* Conduct multiple rounds of pre\-launch QA across logic, aesthetics, respondent flow, language handling, and overall user experience before exposing links to clients or sample partners.
* Ensure all client comments and revisions are implemented accurately and validated thoroughly.



**Sample \& Vendor Management** 



* Coordinate with internal panel assets and external sample/vendor partners for feasibility, pricing, quota distribution, and field monitoring.
* Monitor incidence rates, conversion trends, dropout points, and supply quality during fieldwork.
* Optimize sample allocation and vendor mix to balance quality, timelines, and project profitability.
* Handle vendor communication professionally while maintaining accountability on deliverables and quality expectations.



**Data Quality \& Validation** 



* Take ownership of overall data integrity and respondent quality throughout project execution.
* Identify and remove:
* Speeders
* Straight\-liners
* Duplicate respondents
* AI/fraudulent responses
* Gibberish or poor\-quality open ends
* Contextually inconsistent responses
* Apply contextual and logical validations beyond automated checks to ensure reliable and research\-ready datasets.
* Work closely with Data Processing teams on data cleaning logic, variable mapping, coding structures, weighting requirements, and final outputs.



**Operational Excellence \& Automation Mindset** 



* Be highly proficient in Excel and operational data handling including:
* VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP
* Pivot tables
* Advanced formulas
* Data cleaning
* Validation techniques
* Large dataset handling
* Leverage automation tools, AI\-assisted workflows, and operational efficiencies to improve turnaround time and reduce manual dependency.
* Maintain strong process discipline, documentation standards, and execution accuracy while handling multiple live studies simultaneously.



**Budget \& Commercial Awareness** 



* Track project costs, sample spends, vendor allocation, and operational profitability throughout execution.
* Coordinate closely with internal stakeholders to ensure projects remain commercially viable while maintaining quality standards.



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications**




**Experience** 



* 4–7 years of experience in online quantitative market research project management.
* Prior experience handling international research studies across US, UK, APAC, or Middle East markets preferred.
* Experience in agency\-side or full\-service research environments strongly preferred.



**Technical \& Research Understanding** 




 Strong operational understanding of:
 


* Online survey methodologies
* Questionnaire structures
* Survey logic and routing
* Quota management
* Conjoint and MaxDiff studies
* Tabulation planning
* Data validation workflows
* Online panel ecosystems and sampling methodologies



 Exposure to:
 


* Decipher
* Sawtooth
* SPSS/tabulation workflows
* Automation and AI\-assisted operational tools is highly preferred.



**Core Competencies** 



* Exceptional attention to detail
* Strong ownership mindset
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
* Fast learner with high adaptability
* Strong analytical and logical thinking skills
* Calm under pressure with strong prioritization ability
* High responsiveness and communication discipline
* Strong operational accountability



  





**Why Join BioBrain?**



* Work with a global client base across diverse industries and research methodologies.
* Be part of a highly agile, technology\-driven research organization focused on automation, operational excellence, and innovation.
* Gain exposure to advanced research operations, AI\-integrated workflows, and international market research ecosystems.
* Opportunity to grow into strategic operations, client leadership, automation, and research consulting roles.



  





 Please apply directly to Nikita@biobrain.io and apply only if you can join within 30 days or have a notice period of 30 days or less.

title: Supply Chain Digital Transformation Lead
description:
**About the Role** 




  





 The Supply Chain Digital Transformation Lead is responsible for leading the end\-to\-end digital transformation of the supply chain function through the application of technology, data and artificial intelligence, spanning demand planning, supply planning, procurement, distribution and cost. It is accountable for identifying, evaluating and implementing the digital tools and applications that transform each process, and for leading the associated change through to adoption.
 



 Working across the planning, procurement, distribution, finance and technology teams, the role sets the digital transformation agenda, develops the business case for technology and artificial intelligence investment, and leads the selection, implementation and adoption of supply chain applications. The function leaders retain ownership of their processes and outcomes; the role partners with them to ideate, evaluate and deploy the right solutions and to strengthen the overall capability, efficiency and effectiveness of the supply chain.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 A. Digital Strategy \& Technology Roadmap
 


* Define the multi\-year technology and AI roadmap for the supply chain, prioritizing the tools and applications to be introduced across planning, sourcing, distribution and cost.
* Evaluate and select supply chain solutions through build\-versus\-buy assessment, vendor and platform evaluation, and proof\-of\-concept against clearly defined use cases.
* Build the business case for each technology investment, covering value at stake, cost and sequencing, and secure leadership alignment behind it.



 B. Planning Systems — Demand \& Supply
 


* Identify, evaluate and implement Integrated Business Planning (IBP) and AI\-based demand forecasting to replace spreadsheet\-based, brand\-wise planning, with the S\&OP leader owning the planning process.
* Deploy the Auto\-Replenishment System (ARS) and inventory\-optimization tools for supply planning, working with the supply planning leader who owns norms and service levels.
* Configure the planning applications, integrations and data flows, and transition operational ownership to the planning leaders.



 C. Sourcing \& Procurement Systems
 


* Evaluate and implement e\-sourcing and e\-auction platforms, contract lifecycle management (CLM) and supplier relationship management (SRM), with the category leaders owning sourcing strategy and negotiations.
* Introduce spend analytics, should\-cost and commodity\-index tools to support category and cost decisions.
* Digitize supplier onboarding, performance scorecards and share\-of\-business tracking on a common platform.



 D. Warehouse, Logistics \& Network Systems
 


* Warehouse Management (WMS) and Transport Management (TMS) systems
* Deploy network\-optimization and route\-optimisation tools to inform network design and secondary distribution.
* Implement a supply chain control tower for network\-wide visibility, exception management and early\-warning alerts.



 E. Cost, Analytics \& Decision Systems
 


* Implement cost\-to\-serve and costing\-and\-allocation tools that provide a clear, system\-based view of where cost sits across the value chain, with SC Finance owning the numbers.



 F. Data, AI \& Automation Platforms
 


* Identify and implement workflow automation and process automation to remove manual, repetitive tasks across supply chain processes.
* Establish the data foundation, master data and integration layer required for reliable analytics and AI across the applications landscape.
* Ideate, pilot and scale artificial intelligence and machine\-learning use cases — such as forecasting, anomaly detection and prescriptive recommendations — in partnership with IT and solution providers.



 Key Projects \& Initiatives
 


* The role will lead a portfolio of digital initiatives that convert core supply chain processes from manual to system\-run. Indicative programmers include:
* Advanced demand planning and AI\-based forecasting — a statistical and machine\-learning forecasting engine integrated with auto\-replenishment.
* MRP automation in SAP (SAP\-VC) — automated material requirement planning, purchase scheduling and vendor call\-off.
* Auto\-replenishment and auto\-indent (ARS) — system\-driven store and distribution\-Centre replenishment based on demand signals.
* Supply chain control tower — a single, real\-time view for exception management and early\-warning alerts.
* Analytics and management dashboards (e.g., Tableau) — automated MIS, self\-service reporting and Capex and new\-store (NSO) pipeline tracking.



 Key Relationships
 



 Internal
 


* Head of Supply Chain Management \& Logistics — reporting line and transformation sponsor.
* Demand Planning \& S\&OP, Supply Planning, Category Management \& Procurement, Capex \& NSO, and Warehouse, Logistics \& Distribution, SC Finance — cost, costing analysis and value realization.
* IT, Digital and Business teams — joint partners in delivering supply chain technology and AI solutions and adopting the new ways of working.



 External
 


* Management consultants and transformation advisors.
* Supply chain benchmarking and best\-practice networks.
* Key suppliers, 3PL and logistics partners.
* Technology, AI and solution providers.



 Qualifications \& Experience
 


* 7–12 years in supply chain, with a strong track record of leading technology\- and AI\-enabled transformation across planning, procurement and distribution.
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, Technology, Supply Chain or Operations; a postgraduate qualification (MBA / SCM) is preferred.
* Deep expertise in supply chain technology \& tools including advanced planning, automation, analytics and AI/ML applications.
* Demonstrated success leading digital transformation programmers end to end, from strategy and business case through to implementation and adoption.
* Strong grounding in cost and costing analysis, value realization and business\-case development.
* Exposure to QSR, food, FMCG or multi\-site retail distribution, or a management\-consulting background, is an advantage.



 Skills \& Competencies
 


* Deep understanding of the end\-to\-end supply chain and its digital and AI enablement — demand and supply planning, procurement, distribution and cost.

title: Senior Associate - Consumer & Retail Consulting
description:
**Job Title: Senior Associate \- Consumer \& Retail Consulting** 




  





 Location: Gurgaon, Haryana, India
 



 Experience: 4–8 years
 



  





**About the Company** 




 Alvarez \& Marsal is a global professional services firm helping organizations tackle complex business issues, improve operating performance and maximize stakeholder value. Founded in 1983, A\&M is known for practical, action\-oriented advisory, business performance improvement, turnaround management and interim leadership services across industries and geographies. Its professionals combine independent thinking, deep expertise and an operator mindset to deliver measurable results for clients. The India Global Capability Center partners with A\&M leadership and case teams across the Americas, EMEA and APAC, supporting end\-to\-end client delivery, thought leadership, digital enablement and analytics. The Consumer and Retail Group works with companies across consumer products and retail to address disruption, strengthen performance and create growth. A\&M’s culture is guided by integrity, quality, objectivity, fun, personal reward and inclusive diversity, with founding principles centered on leadership, action and results.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 As a Senior Associate in the Consumer \& Retail Group, you will own medium\-to\-complex workstreams across corporate transformation and performance improvement engagements. You will translate ambiguous client questions and operational data into fact\-based insights, practical recommendations and measurable actions across consumer products and retail. Working in a flat team with Managers, Directors and senior clients, you will lead analyses, manage key stakeholder relationships and help deliver outcomes across market assessment, growth strategy, supply chain, pricing, merchandising, store operations and financial performance. The role combines analytical depth with commercial judgment, clear communication and hands\-on execution. You will also contribute to pitches, thought leadership, capability building and mentoring, while working onsite from Gurgaon and remaining open to business travel and potential future relocation within the India capability center.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own medium\-to\-complex workstreams from problem definition through client\-ready output, using structured analysis to identify performance gaps and convert findings into practical transformation actions.
* Develop Consumer and Retail solutions across consumer products and retail sectors, connecting market, operational and financial metrics to growth strategy, value creation and improved client performance.
* Analyze and benchmark data across supply chain, inventory planning, pricing, merchandising, digital, brand assessment, G\&A and store operations to surface underperformance and prioritize interventions.
* Lead client and internal stakeholder interactions by clarifying requirements, communicating insights and explaining business impact to senior CRG clients, A\&M leaders and third parties.
* Build accurate models, dashboards and presentations using Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI, Tableau, Alteryx or Python to support timely decisions and zero\-defect deliverables.
* Manage milestones, dependencies and competing priorities under pressure, while collaborating with team members to deliver agreed outputs and maintain momentum across projects.
* Support A\&M growth through pitch development, marketing, innovative offering development, recruiting, training and mentoring Analysts and Associates.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* Strong Consumer Products and Retail expertise, including sector data and metrics across supply chain, inventory planning, pricing, merchandising, digital, brand assessment, G\&A and store operations.
* Demonstrated experience in strategy, analytics, operational consulting or transformation, with the ability to structure ambiguous problems and deliver fact\-based recommendations that influence client decisions.
* Advanced Excel modelling and analytical skills, including organizing complex data to draw conclusions, test scenarios and support timely operational and financial decision\-making.
* Strong PowerPoint capability, with a track record of creating clear, persuasive and defect\-free presentations for senior clients, leadership teams and business development discussions.
* Working proficiency in Power BI or Tableau for data visualization and Alteryx or Python for data analysis, with the judgment to select appropriate tools for each problem.
* Excellent written, verbal, research and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate difficult messages with integrity and explain analytical impact to varied stakeholders.
* Practical leadership, prioritization and teamwork skills, including mentoring junior colleagues, motivating teams and delivering high\-quality work in pressured environments.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* Experience across multiple Consumer Products or Retail subsectors, such as Food and Beverage, Personal Care, Household Goods, Health and Wellness, Electronics, Grocery, Apparel or E\-Commerce.
* Exposure to corporate transformation, performance improvement, operating model change or financial enhancement programs in a consulting or industry setting.
* Interest in developing thought leadership, new offerings and client relationships within a growing global Consumer and Retail practice.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* A graduate degree from a strong institution and 4–8 years of relevant experience, including 3–6 years of post\-MBA experience in strategy, analytics, operational consulting or a comparable transformation environment.
* A commercially minded Consumer and Retail problem solver who understands how industry metrics connect across growth, operations, customer experience and financial performance.
* An entrepreneurial, self\-starting approach: you are comfortable with ambiguity, require limited direction, challenge the status quo and take ownership through to measurable client outcomes.
* The communication, judgment and integrity to lead workstreams, mentor Analysts and Associates, influence senior stakeholders and deliver messages clearly even when they are difficult to hear.



  





**Why Join Us** 




 You will join a rapidly growing Consumer and Retail team where your work directly shapes high\-impact transformation programs for global clients. The role offers exposure across the full project life cycle, from market analysis and growth strategy through operational improvement and financial performance enhancement. You will work closely with Managers, Directors and senior client stakeholders in a flat structure that rewards ownership, sound judgment and practical execution. A\&M’s entrepreneurial culture gives high\-performing professionals early responsibility and the opportunity to influence both client outcomes and the growth of the practice. You will deepen your expertise across consumer products and retail subsectors while contributing to pitches, thought leadership, new offerings and capability building. The India Global Capability Center connects you to colleagues and case teams across the Americas, EMEA and APAC, creating a genuinely global platform for learning and impact. Development is supported through mentorship, formal training, performance feedback, on\-the\-job learning and internal mobility. Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits accompany a culture that values integrity, inclusion, personal growth and results.
 



  





**What We Offer** 



* Direct exposure to senior A\&M leaders, global case teams and client stakeholders, with meaningful ownership of workstreams and visible influence on transformation outcomes.
* Structured professional development through mentorship, performance feedback, formal training, on\-the\-job learning and opportunities to build expertise across Consumer and Retail sectors.
* A collaborative, entrepreneurial environment with competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, well\-being resources, inclusive diversity initiatives and opportunities to contribute beyond client delivery.

title: Manager Impact, India and Southeast Asia
company: The Global Energy Alliance for People and Planet
description:
The Global Energy Alliance for People and Planet (Global Energy Alliance) The Global Energy Alliance for People and Planet (Global Energy Alliance) works for a world where everyone has access to affordable, reliable, clean electricity and the means to use it to improve their lives. Our Alliance builds transformative public, private, philanthropic partnerships to end energy poverty and accelerate green economic opportunity. Founded in 2021 by The Rockefeller Foundation, IKEA Foundation, and Bezos Earth Fund, we design innovative projects/programs, unlock finance, strengthen institutions and transform markets, delivering progress anchored in deep community engagement. By uniting actors across the value chain, from households to heads of state, we go beyond individual projects to drive lasting systems change. With work in more than 30 countries across Africa, Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean, our Alliance aims to reach 1 billion people with clean electricity, prevent 4 billion tons of carbon emissions and create or improve 150 million jobs.
   

  

**Contract type: Fulltime, Open ended**
**Reports Directly To**
 Direct Reports:
   

  

**Matrix/Dual Reports**
 Chief Impact Officer
   

  

 None
   

  

 VP, India; MD, Grids of the Future
   

  

**Overview Of The Role**
 Global Energy Alliance for People and Planet’s goals are bold and audacious. We recognize that the path to a just energy transition worldwide will be complex, non\-linear, and filled with successes and opportunities, alongside failures and challenges. The Manager, Impact, India and Southeast Asia will support our effort to measure our contribution to impact through evaluations, monitoring and learning. Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning (MEL) is embedded within our operating model, to ensure that we have an ear to the ground so we remain responsive and opportunistic, while generating insights that support continuous improvement.
   

  

 Stepping into a start\-up environment, the Manager, Impact, India and Southeast Asia will lead monitoring, evaluation and learning for the India and Southeast Asia portfolio, guided by the organization’s Impact framework. They will also lead impact measurement for the Grids of the Future pillar across all regions, and provide monitoring and analytics support across the global portfolio. They will be responsible for independently establishing the routine and long\-term work component of these workstreams, ensuring that they are efficiently managed and executed.
   

  

**Accountabilities** 
  

  

* 
+ Monitoring: Providing backend impact data quality assurance for all India and Southeast Asia transactions. Provide technical advice on target setting, indicators, theory of change mechanisms, causality links for the India and Southeast Asia portfolio. Onboard and train program teams on results monitoring sheets – ensuring compliance. They will also support the monitoring function across the global portfolio, including data compilation, quality checks and analytics for quarterly impact reporting, working alongside the Alliance’s external monitoring and learning partner.
+ Grids of the Future impact: Leading impact measurement for the Grids of the Future pillar across all regions. Developing and maintaining expected\-impact estimates for utility partnerships, grid digitalization, battery energy storage and distributed energy resource programs, working with program teams and external modelling partners. Tracking realized impact against expected impact as programs move through the pipeline, and designing evaluations of utility\-level outcomes such as reliability, losses and effects on consumers.
+ Evaluation: Sourcing and managing independent evaluation partners working closely with the Director of Evaluation. Establishing the pulse on what needs evaluation and when by closely working with the India and Southeast Asia and Grids of the Future teams in sourcing evaluation questions. Selecting fit for purpose evaluation approaches and tools and sense checking their design and functionality.
+ Learning: Support the team in designing and managing ongoing reflection, sense\-making, and learning from the work to inform potential shifts in strategy when necessary, using data and evidence to rationalize change.
+ Capacity building: Onboarding, training and operationalizing Impact functions in country teams, solution teams and hiring monitoring evaluation and learning consultants. Ensuring that all requirements per the Impact framework are met in the investment cycle for all India and Southeast Asia programs.
+ Systems integration: Ensuring the internal Global Energy Alliance systems tracking progress on program implementation, financial execution and impact measuring are integrating, working in close collaboration with the IT systems manager, the management teams for country programs and scalable solutions and the Investment team.
+ Advisory function: Advising global Impact colleagues and external technical providers by ground truthing India and Southeast Asia portfolio realities.


**BEHAVIORAL COMPETENCIES**
**Preferred Attributes**
* Working in Partnership: Learning with, learning from, and learning for our partners, particularly those who are closest to the work on the ground. Balancing the needs of multiple stakeholders and working in partnership wherever possible.
* Directs Work: Being strategic with efforts and generating information that informs decision making and improves impact. Providing direction and removing obstacles to get work done.
* Manages Complexity: Makes sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
* Values Differences: Recognizes the value of different perspectives and commits to inclusion, equity, and diversity in every aspect of work.
* Intellectual Humility: We know that we don’t have all the answer. We strive to be equally comfortable talking about what is not working as we are celebrating our successes. We listen to the voices of those we serve.
* Innovation and Entrepreneurial Spirit: A self\-starter who takes initiative to identify areas of improvement and uses an energetic, pragmatic, and creative approach to optimize practice; embodying ‘Start\-Up Philosophy.’


**Required Experience**
* 10\-15 years of experience in monitoring, evaluation, and learning.
* Advanced degree in relevant subjects such as economics, public policy, or similar areas with strong training in evaluation, monitoring and learning.
* Experience in developing best\-in\-class monitoring, evaluation and learning approaches including designing and establishing these systems from scratch. Ideal experience gained in a complex organizational environment.
* Substantial experience of monitoring, evaluation and learning in the context of climate and energy programs, and/or programs driving systems change. Experience with contribution analysis will be a plus.
* Experience measuring the impact of grid infrastructure, utility performance or battery energy storage programs, including modelling expected impacts and validating them against realized results.
* Experience working in India and Southeast Asia, with familiarity with the region’s energy sector, utilities and government programs.
* Experience working independently in a fast\-paced environment.
* Experience working with contractors, consultants to ensure value for money and quality actionable outcomes.
* Exceptional attention to detail.
* Strong writing skills.
* Expertise in STATA, R or similar software packages, and MS Excel.
* Experience with Power BI or other dashboard tools, data engineering and applied use of AI tools for analysis will be a plus.


 Please submit your application on or before
 **2 October COB.** 
 The Global Energy Alliance reserves the right to close the job advert early if we receive a high number of suitable applications.
   

  

*We operate from a strong commitment to equity, diversity, and inclusion in everything we do. It is not only the right thing to do – we could not make an impact without our team members' diverse perspectives and experiences. We expect all Global Energy Alliance employees to contribute by developing their unique perspectives and talent, challenging conventional wisdom through evidence and reason, and amplifying marginalized voices.*

**Location: Gurugram \- WFO**

**About the Role** 




 We’re looking for a data\-driven, hands\-on Logistics Manager to lead client's overall B2B logistics operations.
 



  





 Marketplaces such as Amazon, Flipkart, Blinkit and Instamart will be the primary focus, alongside D2C, Modern Trade and General Trade.
 



  





 You’ll own the complete logistics and fulfilment lifecycle from inbound procurement and warehousing to inventory, order fulfilment, transportation and last\-mile delivery. You’ll also lead 3PL and logistics partners, optimise costs and service levels, and ensure reliable, on\-time fulfilment across channels.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 B2B, Marketplace \& D2C Logistics
 



 • Own end\-to\-end logistics operations across B2B, with marketplaces as the primary focus.
 



 • Manage logistics across Amazon, Flipkart, Blinkit, Instamart and other marketplace platforms.
 



 • Manage FBA, seller\-fulfilled and quick\-commerce/dark\-store models.
 



 • Plan and position inventory to meet marketplace SLAs and regional demand.
 



 • Define and monitor order\-to\-delivery TATs by platform and region.
 



 • Ensure accurate and timely dispatches against marketplace delivery windows.
 



 • Manage D2C order processing, courier performance, NDR reduction, RTO control and customer experience.
 



 • Maintain SOPs, CAPAs and audit readiness across logistics operations.
 



  





 Order Fulfilment \& Last\-Mile
 



 • Own fulfilment across marketplaces, D2C and other B2B channels.
 



 • Maintain 98%\+ fulfilment performance across marketplace operations.
 



 • Drive same\-day dispatch through effective cut\-off and dispatch planning.
 



 • Define and monitor delivery SLAs by zone and channel.
 



 • Track and improve OTIF, fill rate, dispatch accuracy and inventory accuracy.
 



 • Identify operational gaps and implement corrective actions to improve service levels.
 



  





 Transportation \& 3PL Management
 



 • Evaluate, onboard and manage 3PL warehouses based on business expansion and serviceability requirements.
 



 • Identify and onboard transporters and courier partners for B2B movement.
 



 • Negotiate rates, SLAs and commercial terms with logistics partners.
 



 • Plan lane\-wise routing, load planning and milk\-run schedules.
 



 • Monitor POD closures and ensure timely documentation.
 



 • Optimise freight costs through FTL/PTL consolidation, route planning and better load utilisation.
 



 • Continuously evaluate logistics partners on cost, service quality and SLA performance.
 



  





 Team Leadership \& Process Improvement
 



 • Lead and mentor an on\-ground B2B logistics team of 7–8 members, including warehouse supervisors, dispatch executives and transport coordinators.
 



 • Drive improvements in delivery TAT, operational efficiency and cost\-to\-serve.
 



 • Identify opportunities for process automation and standardisation.
 



 • Build clear operational KPIs and visual dashboards for the logistics function.
 



 • Conduct periodic performance reviews and present key insights and action plans to leadership.
 



 • Work closely with procurement, sales, finance, operations and other cross\-functional teams.
 



  





**What We’re Looking For** 




 • 5–8 years of experience in logistics or supply chain management.
 



 • Strong experience managing B2B, General Trade or distributor\-led logistics operations.
 



 • Experience in FMCG, food, D2C or e\-commerce is preferred.
 



 • Proven experience managing B2B and D2C logistics or distribution networks, including depot/CFA operations.
 



 • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering.

title: Preventive Public Health
description:
**About the Company**




 The organisation enables young Indians to pursue high\-impact, purpose\-driven careers in nation building. It believes in the power of youth to drive collective change and provides young professionals with the platform to create societal impact. NationBuilding Foundation of India drives interventions to address the most pressing challenges affecting India across priority themes, with sports and health among its focus areas.
 



  





 NationBuilding Foundation of India is looking for an experienced public health researcher or policy professional to lead research at the intersection of preventive health, public policy, and governance in India.
 



 You will lead the Preventive Healthcare Vertical’s research function, providing technical and intellectual leadership across research, evidence generation, and policy advisory to ensure that our work is scientifically rigorous, policy\-relevant, and grounded in the realities of India’s public health landscape.
 



  





**Key responsibilities include:** 




  




* Setting the organisation’s preventive health research agenda
* Leading evidence generation and analytical research, including literature reviews, evidence synthesis, health systems research, and cost\-effectiveness modelling
* Building institutional research capability
* Tracking emerging evidence and methodological developments
* Training and mentoring generalist policy team members
* Building relationships with health researchers, public health experts, academicians, health administrators, medical practitioners and allied professionals
* Engaging with government stakeholders, clients, and allied institutions
* Supporting publications, podcasts, workshops, and other public\-facing advocacy efforts



  





**This role is well\-suited for an experienced public health researcher or policy professional seeking to lead research at the intersection of preventive health, public policy, and governance in India. It is ideal for individuals who are committed to advancing evidence\-informed public health and driving meaningful impact through research, partnerships, and policy engagement. The role offers the opportunity to build and lead an institutional research function, influence high\-level government decision\-making, and contribute to long\-term improvements in population health.** 




  





**Eligibility criteria**




**Must have:** 




 ● 5\-10 years of relevant experience in preventive healthcare research, epidemiology, health systems research, health policy, population health, or allied research domains, with a demonstrated track record of leading research programmes and policy\-facing work.
 



  





 ● A postgraduate or doctoral qualification from a tier I or tier II institute in the following or similar
 



 disciplines:
 



 ○ Medicine (MBBS/MD Community Medicine/DNB)
 



 ○ Public Health (MPH/MSPH/PhD)
 



 ○ Community Medicine/Preventive \& Social Medicine
 



 ○ Health Policy \& Health Systems
 



 ○ Epidemiology/Biostatistics
 



 ○ Health Economics/Health Financing
 



 ○ Nutrition \& Food Policy
 



  





 ● Demonstrated experience working with or within government health and research institutions, such as the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR), National Centre for Disease Control (NCDC), Ministry of Health \& Family Welfare (MoHFW), National Health Mission (NHM), NITI Aayog, state health departments, or equivalent public sector institutions, with experience contributing to evidence generation, policy development, technical advisory, or programme implementation.
 



  





 ● Demonstrated expertise in research methodology, evidence synthesis, epidemiological analysis,
 



 disease burden estimation, health systems research, economic evaluation, quantitative modelling,
 



 and scientific writing. Experience using Indian public health datasets and translating evidence into
 



 policy is highly desirable.
 



  





 ● A strong publication and policy portfolio, including peer\-reviewed publications (preferably as first or lead author), technical reports, government publications, or policy papers, with experience presenting research at national or international forums.
 



  





 ● Experience leading research teams or programmes, including mentoring researchers, setting research priorities, managing quality assurance processes, and building institutional research capability.
 



  





 ● Established relationships with government institutions, academia, development partners, or
 



 multilateral organisations, with the ability to engage senior stakeholders and represent the
 



 organisation in technical consultations and policy discussions.
 



  





 ● Exceptional analytical and strategic thinking skills, with the ability to identify priority research
 



 questions, critically evaluate evidence, and develop actionable, policy\-relevant recommendations for complex public health challenges.
 



  





 ● Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated experience authoring policy papers, technical reports, ministerial briefs, grant proposals, and presentations tailored for senior government and policy audiences.
 



  





 ● Ability to build and sustain strategic partnerships, collaborate across multidisciplinary teams, and
 



 thrive in a fast\-paced, high\-impact policy environment while maintaining the highest standards of
 



 scientific rigour and integrity.
 



  





**Good to have:**




 ● Experience leading or advising national or state\-level preventive health programmes, health system reforms, or population health initiatives, particularly in partnership with government institutions.
 



  





 ● Experience collaborating with international organisations, development partners, research institutions, and think tanks such as WHO, UNICEF, the World Bank, PATH, CHAI, PHFI, or equivalent organisations on public health research or policy initiatives.
 



  





 ● Strong professional network within the public health ecosystem, with established relationships across government, academia, multilateral organisations, and the research community that can facilitate high\-quality collaborations and policy engagement.
 



  





 ● Expertise in advanced epidemiological and health economics methods, including disease burden
 



 estimation, economic evaluation, cost\-effectiveness analysis, priority\-setting frameworks, and
 



 quantitative modelling to support evidence\-informed policymaking.
 



  





 ● Proficiency with analytical and statistical tools such as R, Stata, Python, SQL, GIS platforms, or
 



 equivalent software used for epidemiological analysis, health systems research, and quantitative
 



 modelling.
 



  





**Role location:**




 This is a full\-time, in\-office role based in Gurugram, Haryana.

 Here's what you'll need

**About Tarutium**
 Tarutium Global Consulting (pronounced as taru\-shee\-yum) delivers transformative insights, strategies, and solutions to drive sustainable, resilient, and inclusive global progress. Our mission is to \`bridge the Science\-Institutions\-Society interface with a core agenda of providing transformative solutions to the development challenges. Established in 1996 by eminent development professionals, it caters to a diverse range of bilateral and multi\-lateral agencies, government departments, corporations, and other development organizations through research, technology, solution innovations, and implementation support. Over the past two and a half decades, Tarutium has undertaken policy analysis, strategy development, action research, technical assistance, program design, project management support, assessments, and evaluations. We have addressed various institutional, financial, economic, social, and technical issues across diverse public systems, cultures, and corporate formations.
   

  

 Tarutium works in Africa, the Middle East, South Asia, and Southeast Asian countries like Afghanistan, Indonesia, Nepal, Bhutan, Maldives, UAE, Eswatini, Bangladesh, Tanzania, Myanmar and others. The organization is committed to quality, accuracy, and succinctness in its consulting and advisory services. Tarutium’s team of professionals has extensive national and international experience and a strong network of advisors, consultants, partner institutions, and associations worldwide. Our expertise spans critical sectors such as climate, disaster management, sustainability, infrastructure, urban services, social impact, economic growth, entrepreneurship, behaviour change, health, and more. By focusing on innovation and collaboration, we empower businesses, governments, foundations, and institutions with the knowledge, solutions, and tools they need to thrive in an ever\-changing global landscape.
   

  

 For more information, visit our website
 **www.tarutium.com**
**Duties And Responsibilities**
 Tarutium Global Consulting, through its Centre for Sustainable Health, is committed to advancing evidence\-based and equitable health solutions across India and globally. The organization works at the intersection of science, policy, and community systems, focusing on priority areas that address emerging and persistent health challenges. Tarutium’s key thematic areas include oral health; maternal and child health; and climate and health—covering disease surveillance, air quality, heat\-health, and climate\-sensitive diseases; occupational health; mental health; wellness and nutrition; senior health; and the integration of health and technology. These focus areas are approached through a systems thinking lens and implemented across both urban and rural contexts.
   

  

 In line with its strategic vision to scale and deepen impact, Tarutium is seeking to hire an Associate Consultant – Sustainable Health. This position will provide essential support to the organization’s growing portfolio in climate and health, wellness, and nutrition initiatives at the national, regional, and state levels. The Associate Consultant will work closely with cross\-functional teams and external stakeholders to drive program design, implementation, and evaluation while ensuring alignment with Tarutium’s core values of innovation, equity, and impact.
   

  

 The incumbent will play a critical role in leading and supporting diverse functions, including business development, proposal writing, project execution, stakeholder engagement, partnership cultivation, and client relations. Additionally, the role will contribute to knowledge management, team coordination, and the monitoring and reporting of activities. This is an exciting opportunity for a motivated and mission\-driven public health professional to contribute to transformative health initiatives and help shape Tarutium’s growing impact in sustainable public health systems.
   

  

**Key Functions**
 He/she will perform the following functions:

* Align work practices with Tarutium’s culture and leadership expectations.

**Knowledge Works**

****Overview****
**About the Organisation**
 Jhpiego is an international, non\-profit health organization and an affiliate of Johns Hopkins University, dedicated to improving the health of women and families in developing countries. For over 50 years, it has focused on providing high\-quality, low\-cost health care solutions, training health workers, and strengthening health systems.
   

  

 Jhpiego has been working in India since the 1980s in close partnership with national and state governments. With deep technical expertise and strong on\-the\-ground execution, Jhpiego helps design, test, and scale practical solutions and innovations that fit real\-world systems across 11 thematic domains (Maternal and Newborn Health, Reproductive Health, Nutrition, Immunization, Comprehensive Primary Health Care, Human Resources for Health, TB and Infectious Diseases, Global Health Security, Common Cancer, Non\-Communicable Diseases, Digital Health).
   

  

****About The Program****
 The Cancer, NCD and Mental Health portfolio aims to strengthen India's response to the growing burden of non\-communicable diseases by supporting governments to design, implement and scale sustainable models of prevention, early detection, diagnosis, treatment and survivorship.
   

  

 The portfolio currently supports programs across common cancers (breast, cervical, oral and lung cancers), chronic NCDs, mental health, comprehensive primary healthcare, digital health, implementation research, market shaping and health systems strengthening. The program works closely with national and state governments, development partners, academia, professional bodies and the private sector to develop scalable models that contribute towards India's National Programme for Prevention and Control of Non\-Communicable Diseases (NP\-NCD).

title: Program Manager
description:
What This Role Is
   

  

 Every year, hundreds of thousands of students across India decide they want to study abroad. Some come through K12 school partnerships, some find their way in directly. Either way, they enter a journey \- discovery, counseling, application, offer, enrollment \- that runs through dozens of handoffs between people, platforms, and teams. When that journey works, a student ends up at a university that fits their budget, their course, and their ambitions, and the business realizes revenue at the moment they enroll. When it doesn't, applications stall, deadlines slip, and a student who could have enrolled goes quiet.
   

  

 The problem is not that any single team is failing. It's that the highest\-leverage work in a business like this doesn't live inside one function \- it lives in the transformation and optimization projects that cut across Tech, Product, Marketing, and Operations, and someone needs to own them end to end. A funnel improvement that Marketing wants tested needs Product to build it and Tech to ship it. A new process that could remove a structural inefficiency needs someone to design it, prove it, and hand it off cleanly. Right now, that ownership happens informally, project by project, and the work that would compound doesn't get the sustained, disciplined execution it needs.
   

  

 This is where this role sits. You will run multiple 'Strategize \- Build \- Operate \- Transfer' projects a year \- some of them genuinely 0\-1 (new ideas that need user research, market research, and hypothesis testing before anyone knows if they work), some of them optimization projects on things that already exist but need better process design and a new benchmark for what good looks like. You will also be asked to take on whatever else is critical for the business to win, even when it doesn't have a job title yet.
   

  

 You will own full\-cycle delivery for these projects \- from framing the problem with the right stakeholders, through build and testing, to launch, operating it long enough to prove it works, and transferring it cleanly to whoever owns it long\-term. You are the person who makes sure a project doesn't just get discussed. It gets shipped, it gets proven, and it gets handed off in a state someone else can run with.
   

  

 What Makes This Role Different
   

  

 Most program management roles ask you to track a roadmap someone else designed. This one asks you to build the roadmap itself \- deciding what the next transformation or optimization project should even be, then owning it across three or four functions that don't naturally report to the same person. The Strategize\-Build\-Operate\-Transfer model means you don't hand a project off the moment it launches; you stay accountable until it's actually working and someone else can run it without you.
   

  

 The Manifest ecosystem gives this role real range: some projects will be genuinely 0\-1 \- a new idea nobody has tested yet \- and others will be 1\-100 \- scaling something that already works but is starting to strain under its own complexity. Few program roles at this stage give you exposure to both ends of that spectrum in the same year.
   

  

 This is a build role, not a maintenance one. There is no finished playbook for how these projects should run \- you're expected to design the frameworks, set the benchmarks, and prove through disciplined experimentation what should scale and what shouldn't.
   

  

 What You Own
   

  

**Transformation projects (Strategize \- Build \- Operate \- Transfer)**
* Translate a business problem into a project plan that Tech, Product, Marketing and Business teams can actually execute against
* Own the full lifecycle of assigned projects \- scoping, stakeholder alignment, build, testing, launch, and post\-launch review
* Own multiple SBOT\-cycle projects a year, end to end, from initial strategy through a clean operational handoff
* Define what "operate" looks like well enough to prove a project works before transferring ownership
* Ensure nothing gets handed off half\-finished \- the transfer is only complete when the receiving team can run it without you


**0\-1 initiatives**
* Lead user research, market research, and hypothesis testing on new ideas before committing resources to build them
* Design and run experiments that give a clear read on whether an idea is worth scaling
* Turn ambiguous, early\-stage problems into a testable plan within weeks, not quarters


**Optimization and process design**
* Identify structural inefficiencies across the business and turn them into scoped optimization projects
* Build the frameworks and process designs that make a function run better, not just faster
* Set new benchmarks for what "good" looks like once a process has been redesigned


**Cross\-functional execution and influence**
* Be the connective layer between Tech, Product, Marketing, and Operations so a project doesn't stall in the gap between roadmaps
* Lead cross\-functional execution through credibility, influence, and clear decision\-making rather than formal authority
* Take on whatever else is critical for the business to win, even without a predefined mandate


 What Success Looks Like
   

  

 The markers below reflect where Student Placements is today. We'll calibrate the specifics once you're in the seat. These are directional, not fixed.
   

  

 In your first weeks, you're not shipping yet \- you're building a working map of how projects actually move through Tech, Product, and Marketing today, and forming a point of view on where the highest\-leverage transformation or optimization opportunities sit. You'll know you're on track when stakeholders start coming to you before a project stalls, not after.
   

  

 By the middle of your first year, you've run at least one full SBOT cycle from strategy to clean handoff, and the people around you trust that if you've said something will happen, it will. You've proven, through real experiments rather than opinion, which 0\-1 ideas are worth scaling and which aren't.
   

  

 Longer term, the way the business runs cross\-functional projects looks different because you built it that way \- frameworks that outlast the specific projects they were built for, a track record of transformations that actually stuck, and a reputation as the person who gets called in when something critical and undefined needs to happen.
   

  

 The specifics will be calibrated once you're in the role. The direction won't change.
   

  

 What You Bring
   

  

 You've spent five to eight years building things inside high\-growth environments, and you've likely seen both ends of that growth curve \- the 0\-1 phase, where the job is rapid experimentation, hypothesis testing, and getting an MVP in front of real users, and the 1\-100 phase, where the job becomes process design and managing the complexity that scale creates. You know which mode a problem calls for and you don't try to apply 1\-100 rigor to a 0\-1 problem, or vice versa.
   

  

 You have real comfort operating in ambiguity, and more than that, you're fast at moving from ambiguity to clarity \- you ask the right question early, you don't wait for someone to hand you a clean brief, and you get to a workable answer quickly rather than a perfect one slowly.
   

  

 You think in first principles. When a process is broken, you don't default to the existing framework \- you rebuild the logic from the ground up and design something better, then prove it works before asking anyone to trust it.
   

  

 Most importantly, you read the description of what this role is building and your first reaction was not "this sounds like a coordination job." It was "this is exactly the kind of ambiguous, high\-leverage problem I want to be handed." That's the person this role is for.
   

  

 Why Manifest
   

  

 Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for global human capital mobility \- connecting students, schools, universities, and employers across 50\+ countries. Our portfolio spans Cialfo (AI\-powered college counseling, 2,000\+ schools), BridgeU (university guidance for international schools globally), Kaaiser (trusted study abroad counseling since 1997 across India and Southeast Asia), and Explore (AI\-powered university outreach, 1,000\+ university partners). Together, we move talent across borders at scale. $700B flows annually in remittances from migrant workers. 85M workers will be missing from developed economies by 2030\. We're building the operating system which changes that. $80M raised. Still early.
   

  

 Student Placements is where that infrastructure meets an individual student's decision \- and the transformation and optimization work this role owns is what makes that infrastructure work better at every scale it operates at.
   

  

 Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for global human capital mobility, operating across 50\+ countries.

**Key Skills And Experience**
* Industry \& Domain Experience: Minimum 15 years of experience in Optical Networks, preferably with strong exposure to Subsea Cable Systems and technologies.
* Program \& Project Leadership: Minimum 10 years of Program/Project Management experience leading large, complex customer delivery programs.
* Subsea Project Expertise: Proven experience delivering subsea projects for global customers, carriers, consortiums, or enterprise clients.
* Technical Knowledge: Strong understanding of the subsea domain, optical transport technologies, network deployment, and operational processes.
* Customer\-Facing Leadership: Demonstrated experience in customer\-facing roles, such as Project Manager or Technical Manager, managing stakeholder relationships and customer expectations.

title: SAP Configuration Delivery Lead-Project Manager
description:

**EY Job Description**
**SAP Configuration Delivery Lead / Project Manager**
**Job Title:**
 SAP Configuration Delivery Lead / Project Manager
   

  

**Job Summary:**
 The SAP Configuration Delivery Lead / Project Manager will lead configuration efforts for the global SAP implementation, rollout, migration, and support programs for the EY SAP platform. The role combines SAP delivery leadership, program governance, solution design, data migration, and stakeholder management across geographically distributed teams to deliver controlled releases, reduced delivery risk, and business continuity.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Provide executive\-level delivery leadership for global SAP transformation programs from planning through deployment and steady\-state support.
* Own delivery governance for SAP ECC, S/4HANA, RISE, testing, release management, cutover, and deployment readiness.
* Drive cross\-functional execution across business, functional, technical, application support, infrastructure, and third\-party teams to protect delivery quality and business continuity.


**Key responsibilities include:**
**Project \& Program Management**
* Establish program structure, delivery cadence, governance routines, and decision forums for complex global SAP initiatives.
* Manage scope, timelines, budgets, risks, issues, dependencies, and delivery commitments to support successful outcomes.
* Escalate key risks, resolve delivery blockers, and align decisions across business and technology stakeholders.


**SAP Delivery Leadership**
* Lead functional delivery for SAP ECC, S/4HANA, and RISE transformation initiatives.
* Manage SIT, UAT, regression testing, production cutover, defect management, quality assurance, and release governance.
* Oversee retrofit activities, code synchronization, landscape coordination, and deployment readiness.


**Business Process \& Solution Design**
* Analyze business requirements and translate them into scalable SAP solutions aligned with global business templates.
* Drive solution architecture, process harmonization, and business process improvement across Order\-to\-Cash, Billing, Commercial Project Management, and Customer Relationship Management domains.


**Data Migration \& Systems Integration**
* Be a thought leader on data migration strategy and execution for master and transactional data.
* Coordinate data cleansing, validation, transformation, and reconciliation activities.
* Guide integration design across SAP Integration Suite, APIs, IDocs, SAP BTP, Clean Core, side\-by\-side extensions, and compliance\-related capabilities.


**Stakeholder \& Team Management**
* Engage executive leadership, business stakeholders, and global delivery teams across multiple countries and time zones.
* Lead geographically distributed teams, facilitate issue resolution and change management, and coordinate delivery across matrixed environments.
* Mentor consultants and develop effective project teams through clear direction, knowledge sharing, and delivery discipline.


**Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:**
 The role requires sound judgment across delivery scope, schedule, budget, risk, testing, cutover, data migration, integration, and stakeholder decisions. The candidate will evaluate cross\-functional trade\-offs, facilitate timely decisions, and resolve issues in a global, matrixed SAP environment while protecting release quality, service stability, and business outcomes.
   

  

**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**
* 15\+ years of SAP technical experience, including 5\+ years in architecture or leadership roles.
* Strong command of SAP delivery methods, governance routines, risk controls, testing models, release practices, and global rollout execution.


**Supervision Responsibilities:**
 The role will lead geographically distributed delivery teams across countries and time zones, providing clear direction, mentoring consultants, resolving blockers, and building disciplined project teams.
   

  

**Other Requirements:**
**Job Requirements:**
**To qualify, candidates must have:**
* Bachelor's degree in Electronics \& Communication Engineering or a related discipline.
* 15\+ years of SAP technical experience, including 5\+ years in architecture or leadership roles.
* Demonstrated experience delivering full\-cycle SAP implementations, migrations, production cutovers, and global rollouts.
* Experience leading SAP ECC, S/4HANA, and RISE delivery across testing, release governance, cutover, and deployment readiness.
* Ability to influence executive leadership, business stakeholders, global delivery teams, and third\-party providers in a matrixed environment.
* Preferred certifications include ABAP on Cloud Backend Developer, SAP CPI Integration Developer, and SAP Signavio Process Management Consultant.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we are committed to helping our people develop future\-focused skills and build meaningful careers in a diverse, inclusive, and globally connected environment.
   

  

* Career development: EY provides opportunities to develop future\-focused skills and gain experiences that support long\-term career growth.

* Benefits: EY offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support wellbeing, flexibility, and personal and professional priorities.

**EY \| Building a better working world**

description:

 myNachiketa is the world’s only D2C brand with products that bring the knowledge of the Gita \& Vedas to children. We design innovative products in the form of books, games, videos, workshops, learning programs and more.
 




  






 Our products are based on deep scholarship, with a special focus on ease of use and customer delight. We reach families through our books, digital platforms and programs in India and internationally.
 





 Our products have consistently received 4\.6\+ star ratings on Amazon and have featured as Bestsellers. We have reached over 500K families and have a growing community of parents, children and supporters.
 





 myNachiketa is founded by Varun Aggarwal, co\-founder of Aspiring Minds, which had a $100M exit. We work with a small, high\-performance team with the ambition to take Indian philosophical knowledge to children across the world.
 




  






 Website:
 
 www.mynachiketa.com
 



  





**About the Role** 




  






 We are looking for a
 
**smart, enterprising and execution\-oriented individual** 

 who takes ownership early in their career and works directly with the founder on some of myNachiketa’s most important initiatives.
 





 This is a broad role, where you will work across
 
**program management, marketing, partnerships, community building and fundraising outreach** 

 , while independently owning key projects from planning to execution.
 





 One day you may be improving the Gita Scholar Program. The next, you could be identifying podcasts for founder outreach, building a donor pipeline, planning a workshop, or working on a campaign to grow participation in our programs.
 





 For the right person, this role can grow significantly in scope and responsibility. Responsibilities include: 
 




  





**Own our Programs** 



* Manage and improve the
 
**Gita Scholar Program, Gita Classes, workshops and other learning initiatives** 

 .
* Coordinate with parents, students, schools and partners to ensure programs run smoothly.
* Think beyond execution: identify ways to
 
**increase participation, engagement and impact** 

 .
* Track key metrics and continuously improve how our programs operate.



  





**Build Partnerships** 



* Identify and reach out to
 
**schools, communities, institutions and organizations** 

 that can help expand myNachiketa’s reach.
* Create structured outreach plans and follow through until closure. Build relationships with potential collaborators and partners.
* Research and build databases of
 
**individual donors, foundations, CSR organizations and other potential supporters** 

 .
* Support fundraising outreach, communication and follow\-ups.
* Work directly with the founder on developing relationships with potential supporters and ecosystem partners.



  





**Marketing \& Outreach** 



* Work on outreach initiatives across
 
**LinkedIn, email, podcasts, events and other channels** 

 .
* Identify relevant podcasts, media opportunities, events and forums for myNachiketa and its founders.
* Help conceptualize campaigns to grow awareness, participation and community engagement.
* Work with content and design teams to take campaigns from idea to execution.



  





**What are we looking for** 




  




* **1\.5\+ years of professional experience OR an MBA equivalent postgraduate management degree. Fresh MBAs may apply.**
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational ability and attention to detail.
* High ownership and a bias towards getting things done.
* Ability to independently manage multiple projects and stakeholders.
* Strong research and analytical ability.
* Comfortable with spreadsheets, digital tools and AI.
* Curious and willing to work across functions rather than remain within a narrow job description.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, entrepreneurial environment.
* Prior experience in startups, education, program management, marketing, partnerships, community building or fundraising is a plus.
* An interest in education, Indian philosophy or social impact is useful, but
 
**ability, curiosity and ownership matter more** 

 .



  





**What is in it for you** 




  






 This role is designed for someone who wants
 
**breadth, ownership and rapid learning** 

 early in their career.
 





 You will:
 



* **Work directly with the founder** 

 and get exposure to how decisions are made and initiatives are built.
* Get hands\-on experience across
 
**program management, marketing, partnerships, fundraising and community building** 

 .
